Hey everyone, Matt here.
If you've been following me, you know I don't put much faith in polling. Look at the trends and the sentiment, but remember that the sentiment inside our own bubble can look very different from what is happening outside it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/34a36793-1c74-43be-8442-3532f13c3d41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Republicans expected a red wave in 2022. It failed to materialize the way they promised. Now Democrats are talking about a blue wave crashing over the country like Barack Obama's victory in 2008.
There is real dissatisfaction in this country. I understand why Democrats see an opportunity. But I remain skeptical about the size of the victory people are expecting, especially in Ohio.
The discovery that polling operations were publishing fabricated surveys should give everybody a reason to slow down and look more closely.
* * *
## The Numbers Were Made Up
[Wedgewood Polls admitted that virtually all its published polling was fabricated after an investigation by FiftyPlusOne. ](https://substack.com/redirect/2aedbf17-fae8-4161-9410-76d8ea2f3dfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Earlier this year, a separate operation, Median Strategies, also acknowledged releasing fake surveys.
FiftyPlusOne
[FiftyPlusOne just caught a pollster faking data -- and they copped to it](https://substack.com/redirect/515fa9e7-34e3-4614-9d81-d7717f791a0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
On Tuesday, Oct. 20, FiftyPlusOne reached out to Wedgewood Polls, a self-professed polling firm, with a request for comment on an investigation we had conducted into their alleged survey research. They did not respond to our request, but instead posted a...
[Read more](https://substack.com/redirect/515fa9e7-34e3-4614-9d81-d7717f791a0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2 days ago * 277 likes * 7 comments * Mary Radcliffe, G. Elliott Morris, Cooper Burton, and FiftyPlusOne
Median's releases included a Wisconsin Democratic primary poll showing Francesca Hong with a substantial lead. Wedgewood published fabricated numbers involving Michigan's Senate race, where Abdul El-Sayed ultimately became the Democratic nominee.
[Mallory McMorrow described what happened after a fake Wedgewood survey showed ](https://substack.com/redirect/893c805e-c4af-4c83-9cb4-0071fadb97b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)her support collapsing: donations dried up, volunteers became discouraged, and reporters pressed her about dropping out.
Think about what that means for a campaign. A number gets published, becomes a headline, and starts shaping conversations with donors, volunteers, and voters. The candidate then has to respond to a supposed political reality that somebody invented.
By the time the fabrication is exposed, the fundraising calls, discouraging conversations, and damaging coverage have already happened.
Calling this a "social experiment," as these operations have done, does not erase the consequences.
* * *
## Ohio Was in the Mix
Wedgewood's fabricated Ohio releases claimed to survey likely voters from August 11 through August 13.
[They showed Amy Acton leading Vivek Ramaswamy, ](https://substack.com/redirect/f4283530-060e-484b-87e4-0d5e6c23074f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[47% to 46%](https://substack.com/redirect/f4283530-060e-484b-87e4-0d5e6c23074f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[, and Sherrod Brown leading Jon Husted, ](https://substack.com/redirect/f4283530-060e-484b-87e4-0d5e6c23074f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[48% to 44%](https://substack.com/redirect/f4283530-060e-484b-87e4-0d5e6c23074f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[.](https://substack.com/redirect/f4283530-060e-484b-87e4-0d5e6c23074f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Those numbers appeared in election coverage and prediction-market commentary. They gave readers the impression that another independent survey was confirming Democratic momentum.
Legitimate surveys have also shown competitive Ohio races. But every fabricated poll added to the conversation creates a false sense of corroboration. Readers see several headlines pointing in the same direction and assume the evidence is getting stronger.
Meanwhile, Trump carried Ohio by about **11 points in 2024**. Mike DeWine beat Nan Whaley by roughly **25 points in 2022**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b0b1fcd-da3d-45a3-b9d7-6cf99160887c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That is the recent electoral history Democrats are working against. Candidates and circumstances change, but flipping this state requires a substantial shift in who votes and whom they support.
* * *
## Polling, Betting, and the Feedback Loop
[An August analysis discussing Wedgewood's Ohio Senate numbers reported roughly ](https://substack.com/redirect/f012576e-d1be-412c-857f-93d032f69474?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[277,000 Kalshi contracts traded on August 13](https://substack.com/redirect/f012576e-d1be-412c-857f-93d032f69474?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[.](https://substack.com/redirect/f012576e-d1be-412c-857f-93d032f69474?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That figure measures trading volume and fabricated survey results were being used in commentary about markets where people were wagering real money.
I have raised concerns about prediction markets before. In [Someone Is Creating Prediction Markets for OH-7 Primary](https://substack.com/redirect/43b621d4-e62a-4615-93ed-4833a04cad70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an anonymous researcher helped examine a thinly traded Polymarket race and accounts apparently connected through a common funding source.
The Angry Ohioan
[Someone Is Creating Prediction Markets for OH-7 Primary ](https://substack.com/redirect/5edb2de1-dd4a-493c-8771-382d66d83747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Below is something I found interesting. The TLDR: On Polymarket a total of over $4000 in trading volume is manufacturing an 87% frontrunner...
[Read more](https://substack.com/redirect/5edb2de1-dd4a-493c-8771-382d66d83747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
6 months ago * 3 likes * 1 comment * The Angry Democrat
The concern was how relatively little money could produce an overwhelming-looking probability that voters might mistake for broad agreement about a candidate's chances.
Put those systems together and you can see the problem. A poll feeds coverage. Traders react to information circulating around the race. Market odds become another headline, which people then share as further evidence of momentum.
How much independent information is actually underneath all that confidence?
* * *
## Look at Who Paid for the Poll
The same scrutiny should apply to favorable polling in the Brian Poindexter-Max Miller race.
One Bedrock survey was commissioned by **Iron Workers International and The Next 50** , both supporting Poindexter. Poindexter is an ironworker.
Be skeptical when a poll showing you ahead is commissioned by the union you belong to. Ask who paid for it, how the survey was conducted, what questions came before the candidate matchup, and whether the full results are available.
The union commissioned the work; Bedrock conducted the poll. Readers deserve that distinction, along with the sponsorship disclosure.
We should demand the same transparency from a Republican-funded survey showing Miller ahead. Favorable numbers should invite examination, especially when the people paying for the poll have a stake in the outcome.

But in either case, where are the checks and balances? Too often, researchers, news outlets, and political commentators run with numbers that fit a narrative instead of checking the polling methodology, weighting, and who paid for the work. When fabricated polls can make it into coverage and polling averages, we have to ask who is checking any of this and who is held accountable when they get it wrong.

And now we're getting that transparency less than two weeks before Election Day, after the numbers have circulated for months and early voting has already started. People have donated, volunteered, and cast ballots while fabricated polling was part of the coverage they were seeing. By the time the correction arrives, the damage may already be done.
* * *
## What Does Margin of Error Mean?
Even a legitimate poll can be presented with more certainty than it deserves.
[A survey showing a Democrat at 42% and a Republican at 38%, with a four-point margin of error, does not establish a secure Democratic lead.](https://substack.com/redirect/ad87f799-c229-403d-847e-5a5ebe87b293?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Move the Democrat down four points and the Republican up four, and the result becomes 38% to 42%, reversing who is ahead. People see "up four" and overlook the uncertainty. That is a competitive race, not a guaranteed Democratic win.
That is my point: people see "up four" and treat it as a win while ignoring the uncertainty in the numbers. [The margin of error for the difference between two candidates is larger than the margin reported for either candidate individually.](https://substack.com/redirect/ad87f799-c229-403d-847e-5a5ebe87b293?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) A close poll is evidence of a competitive race, not a victory to celebrate.
Then you have undecided voters, turnout assumptions, and errors that the published margin does not capture.
People see their candidate ahead and mentally move the race into the win column. Enough of those assumptions become a wave narrative.
Gerrymandering adds another obstacle. A favorable national environment still has to translate into wins in districts drawn to favor one party. Enthusiasm across the country does not distribute itself neatly across the seats Democrats need.
* * *
## What About the Rest of the Ballot?
I also want to know whether the enthusiasm around Brown and Acton extends to the rest of Ohio's Democratic ticket.
What is happening in the races for secretary of state, auditor, and treasurer? Are voters broadly reconsidering Republican control, or responding to particular candidates?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bd4f6f4f-cdbf-43ab-8495-e145df04ecd6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Ohio Politics Tracker](https://substack.com/redirect/377f3e6f-111e-4e0e-989f-1a446f8f4297?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That distinction changes how we should understand this election.
A Republican voter might hold their nose and vote for **Sherrod Brown** while supporting Republicans elsewhere. Brown strikes me as a particularly plausible candidate for that crossover support.
But voting for Brown, Acton, and a Democratic congressional candidate on the same ballot requires a broader set of choices. How many normally Republican voters are prepared to make them?
Some will cross over in one race. Others will leave contests blank or stay home. Democrats may bring out voters who skipped the last election.
**Those are the mechanics of winning. They deserve more attention than the assumption that disliking Trump automatically produces a Democratic ballot from top to bottom.**
* * *
## I Want Evidence Before Celebration
Most of my readers are Democrats. That is why I am bringing this conversation here.
We have confirmed fabrications, questions about verification, and political coverage that helped give invented numbers credibility. The evidence warrants scrutiny of the system.
Follow the money. Examine the methodology. Ask aggregators how they vetted these firms and news organizations whether they corrected the stories built around fabricated results.
Apply that scrutiny to the numbers you like.
Democrats have opportunities in Ohio. Winning them requires overcoming the state's recent voting patterns, reaching people outside our bubble, and getting supporters to vote.
I would rather understand the uncertainty now than discover on election night that our confidence was built partly on information somebody made up.
I would rather have skepticism than hopium. No one is more hated than he who speaks the truth.

clean_body: | Friend, Over the past month, we blew pastover 200 stops across Tennessee. If you want to know where this campaign stands right now, just look at the packed venues and overflowing rooms from Memphis to the Tri-Cities, and everywhere in-between. Everywhere we go, folks are telling me t he exact same thing : they are working h arder than ever , but getting crushed by the cost of living. Grocery bills are out of control. Utilities are skyrocketing. People are worried sick about healthcare as rural hospitals close their doors. Meanwhile their elected leaders tell them that the economy has never been better. That is why our message is resonating, and it is why the latest numbers show this race is in a dead heat. We are right on the edge of a historic upset. While Marsha Blackburn is hiding from voters, ducking unscripted questions, and running scared from the idea of a public debate, we are putting in the work and offering a real plan for working families: Lowering everyday costs: Cutting the regressive grocery tax so families keep more of their hard-earned money instead of padding corporate profit margins. Taking on healthcare monopolies: Expanding Medicaid and breaking up regional giants like Ballad Health so care is actually affordable and close to home. Fully funding public schools: Rejecting private school vouchers and investing directly in our neighborhood classrooms and teachers. Ending corruption: Closing loopholes for corporate special interests and holding the powerful accountable. Early voting is happening right now , and Election Day is November 3. We have the other side playing defense, but right now we need every single person in this fight to push us forward across the finish line. Here are the most effective ways you can help right now: Vote Early: Do not wait until November 3. Make your plan to vote today using resources from . Get on the Ground: We need all hands on deck for our final weekend pushes. to check out our latest schedule and sign up to volunteer. Chip In for the final push: TV ads and grassroots organizing cost resources. If you can = , it directly fuels our final push to reach undecided voters. = | | | = | They have the big money and the corporate super PACs. We have the people. Let us finish strong, together. O’Brien Demands Action over Misuse of Public Resources _Attorney General and Secretary of State urged to act before October 29 judicial-conduct_ _conference._
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** October 22nd, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |

**CONCORD, N.H.** — Former New Hampshire House Speaker and current Republican National Committeeman William L. O’Brien today called on Attorney General John M. Formella and Secretary of State David M. Scanlan to intervene before an October 29 partisan judicial-conduct conference that would use public institutions and resources to reinforce Democrat campaign attacks.
“It is outrageous that public institutions would be used to help Democrats promote yet anotherfalse campaign theme five days before an election,” **O’Brien said.** “Democrats working withinthese institutions have no right to commit public money, facilities, and personnel to partisanpoliticking. The Attorney General and Secretary of State must act now, before this conferencetakes place.”
The conference, “Judicial Conduct: Accountability, Due Process, and Public Trust,” is sponsored by UNH Law’s Warren B. Rudman Center and scheduled for October 29, five days before the November 3 general election. UNH’s published promotion of the event identifies two sitting Judicial Conduct Committee members, its Executive Secretary and General Counsel, and two attorneys who perform legal or investigative work for the Committee as the scheduled speakers.
O’Brien’s complaint points to the New Hampshire Democratic Party’s and Cinde Warmington’spromotion of judicial-conduct allegations as a partisan campaign theme. It also highlights theconference’s express invitation to journalists and its planned discussion of the media’s role inreporting on judicial ethics.
“The timing, subject matter, and participants support a strong inference that this program isintended to give official authority and fresh publicity to a Democrat campaign issue,” O’Briensaid. “The ‘educational’ label cannot conceal the political purpose of this event or excuse thepartisan use of public resources.”
The complaint requests immediate preservation of records, investigation of funding andinstitutional approvals, and examination of communications between public officials andcampaigns and party officials. It asks Formella and Scanlan to seek postponement until after the election and take appropriate enforcement action if violations are established.
“Those responsible owe New Hampshire taxpayers a full accounting of the money and staff time committed to this effort,” O’Brien said. “Formella and Scanlan need to stop this politicking with public funds and resources now. An investigation after Election Day cannot undo a political benefit delivered before it.”

| | | | Peter, Let’s talk about why this government decided to uproot the U.S. Forest Service headquarters from Washington, D.C., and relocate it to Utah. The politicians pushing this are blanketing the airwaves with a convenient talking point: this is just about "bringing leadership closer to where the work happens." But that’s false. We know exactly what the strategy is here because we watched them run the exact same playbook in 2020. When the Bureau of Land Management headquarters was scattered out West, **almost 90% of the employees ordered to relocate chose to resign rather than uproot their families.** It stripped the agency of decades of institutional knowledge and effectively crippled it—which was precisely the point. The newest attack on the Forest Service goes even further. By moving headquarters, they are shuttering dozens of critical research centers and closing regional offices right before what is predicted to be a horrific wildfire season. Severing the Forest Service from the seat of power in Washington is a deliberate move to blindfold and bankrupt the agency. Over the last year, roughly a quarter of the Forest Service's 30,000 employees were already coerced or forced out. Now, thousands more are being handed relocation orders. If the BLM history is any guide, the Forest Service will soon be left with roughly half of its former ranks. As a result of this purge, campgrounds will close, trails will crumble, high fuel loads near communities will go unaddressed—making wildfires infinitely harder to fight. And when things inevitably start going wrong on the ground, the politicians who manufactured this crisis will throw up their hands, declare the federal government incompetent, and demand these public lands be sold off to private industry. **And just in case there was any doubt about their end game, look at where they are moving the agency: Utah.** They chose the home turf of Senator Mike Lee—the loudest architect of the public land selloff—and a state that is actively suing the federal government to take over millions of acres of your public lands. It is a bleak picture, but here is the good news: the inevitable does not need to happen. Because they are being so blatant about this corporate land grab, they are handing us the ammunition we need to stop them. The only thing that can prevent our forests from being mismanaged to the point of a fire sale is the organized, overwhelming outrage of the American people. [**We need to blanket the airwaves, expose this engineered collapse, and make supporting this purge politically toxic. clean_body: Let's talk about it Let's talk about it | | | | | Peter, Let’s talk about why this government decided to uproot the U.S. Forest Service headquarters from Washington, D.C., and relocate it to Utah. The politicians pushing this are blanketing the airwaves with a convenient talking point: this is just about "bringing leadership closer to where the work happens." But that’s false. We know exactly what the strategy is here because we watched them run the exact same playbook in 2020. When the Bureau of Land Management headquarters was scattered out West, almost 90% of the employees ordered to relocate chose to resign rather than uproot their families. It stripped the agency of decades of institutional knowledge and effectively crippled it—which was precisely the point. The newest attack on the Forest Service goes even further. By moving headquarters, they are shuttering dozens of critical research centers and closing regional offices right before what is predicted to be a horrific wildfire season. Severing the Forest Service from the seat of power in Washington is a deliberate move to blindfold and bankrupt the agency. Over the last year, roughly a quarter of the Forest Service's 30,000 employees were already coerced or forced out. Now, thousands more are being handed relocation orders. If the BLM history is any guide, the Forest Service will soon be left with roughly half of its former ranks. As a result of this purge, campgrounds will close, trails will crumble, high fuel loads near communities will go unaddressed—making wildfires infinitely harder to fight. And when things inevitably start going wrong on the ground, the politicians who manufactured this crisis will throw up their hands, declare the federal government incompetent, and demand these public lands be sold off to private industry. And just in case there was any doubt about their end game, look at where they are moving the agency: Utah. They chose the home turf of Senator Mike Lee—the loudest architect of the public land selloff—and a state that is actively suing the federal government to take over millions of acres of your public lands. It is a bleak picture, but here is the good news: the inevitable does not need to happen. Because they are being so blatant about this corporate land grab, they are handing us the ammunition we need to stop them. The only thing that can prevent our forests from being mismanaged to the point of a fire sale is the organized, overwhelming outrage of the American people. ~~ ~~ They want to gut the agency in the shadows so they can sell off the land in broad daylight. Let’s make sure they fail. For the wild, Public Land Warriors | Public Land Warriors728 Gilbert StHelena, MT 59601United States "Website"

Peter: meet Nancy Lacore.
After serving 35 years in the U.S. Navy, Vice Admiral Nancy Lacore was fired by Pete Hegseth last year without cause.

name: The Turning Point Action Team
subject: There's a bigger picture here...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TURNING POINT ACTION (TPACTION
body:
Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

| | | |
---
Peter,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let us explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

subject: Deb knows who she’s fighting for

body:
It’s Elizabeth Warren, in New Mexico, supporting my friend, Deb Haaland.

| | |
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1655-fr-nd&t=1&akid=13390%2E400544%2EAcR-SF)
Friend, it’s Sen. Elizabeth Warren.

I was just in New Mexico campaigning alongside my friend Deb Haaland, and let me tell you why: Working families are getting squeezed from every direction. Groceries cost too much. Rent is too high. Childcare is eating up family budgets. And instead of making life easier for working people, Donald Trump and Republicans are going after the healthcare and food assistance millions of families depend on.

**That's why I'm fighting to elect Deb Haaland as New Mexico's next Governor.**
I've worked alongside Deb in Congress. I've seen her stand up to powerful interests and fight for working families. I know what she stands for, and I know she doesn't back down when things get tough. **[_So please, will you donate $5, $10, $25, or whatever you can, today to help elect Deb Haaland as New Mexico’s next Governor? We need leaders who will fight for working families, and Deb is ready to get to work._](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1655-fr-nd&t=2&akid=13390%2E400544%2EAcR-SF)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Donate $10](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17858?refcode=jtk1655-fr-nd&t=3&akid=13390%2E400544%2EAcR-SF)

Childcare is personal to me. I know how hard it can be to balance the cost of care with the demands of work and raising a family. Throughout my career, I’ve fought for working families and policies that make it easier to get ahead.

I know Deb understands that struggle firsthand, too. She raised her child as a single mom, relied on SNAP and WIC, cleaned her child’s preschool to help pay for early education, and started a small salsa business to support her family.

That’s why Deb and I teamed up in Congress to advance legislation to make affordable, quality childcare accessible to families across the country.
Deb has a plan to protect New Mexico's universal childcare program, open more childcare facilities, and raise wages for childcare workers. Her Every Child Outdoor Initiative would also give more kids the chance to learn outside and connect with the land around them.

And while Deb is fighting to expand support for families, Donald Trump and her Republican opponent have backed cuts to critical programs that New Mexicans depend on.

But Deb knows who she’s running for: Parents trying to give their kids a better future, workers who deserve a fair shot, and families who shouldn’t have to choose between paying rent, buying groceries, and seeing a doctor. **[_If you’re ready to stand with her, please donate to Deb’s campaign today and help elect her the next Governor of New Mexico._](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1655-fr-nd&t=7&akid=13390%2E400544%2EAcR-SF)**

subject: Traffickers wanted her silenced
body:
The call came from a hospital.

She was trafficked in her own home. One hospital visit changed everything.

| | | |
---
| |
---
| | God's Children Are Not For Sale
---
|
---
| | | Friend,
---
The call came from a hospital.

A teenage girl had been brought in after passing out. The man who brought her in said he had no idea what was wrong.

He was her father.

The nurses examined her.

**What they found told them everything. **
---
[ Help Rescue the Next Child](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7m5lDxjWBUWU1Uop7tqUaA4GG50BB7BP-feRd69Jex3Mm_c9Pc3vV_OKYQ1pfsNI2h7BlGpaQe-D_aBSPzE1cguVGlZKBnqQL0P_AmDQtnCQEdg5bZ3k0JEe1ATyqkZQ3aIlAOBISk4TXdVE7w4teZjGQaLoPXRBn7ihBxikGAEuTpF4F0ROXH2vnGWi3zeHjerF5lSpHHhmhpTy-crpYnPsVr20tlXGfzC4M7hXsnuhS817ctn7QuRy9Ofv6cllPreyN-vfgo9KBu0fxu8178WSsdkR47efv96GEfgwMpB7iyaSC3tk_EYRw_o1fFoYvy1YHNaPB-kpWYwbhjkxfvsv7EtuVE5YV7TbPsO6hioVE_18wh-92jfPcWj4FwAA__8T2Z7d)
---
Friend, my name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_.

That film moved millions of people to ask, "_What can I do_?"

**Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to answer that question, by helping stop the sale of God's children.

I want to tell you about this girl, because her story shows exactly what it takes to save a child.

**Her name is not Lyra, but this is her true story.**

Lyra grew up in a home where NO ONE kept her safe.

Her mother let the men she brought home hurt her little girl. Then those men brought their friends.

For years, Lyra was abused and trafficked inside her own home.

Through all of it, she never stopped going to school. She was a straight-A student who dreamed of a better life.

At twelve, she found out where her father lived. She ran to him, believing everything would finally change.

**It only got worse**.

Her father began abusing her too. _Then he handed her over to other men. _
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7m5lDxjWBUWU1Uop7tqUaA4GG50BB7BP-feRd69Jex3Mm_c9Pc3vV_OKYQ1pfsNI2h7BlGpaQe-D_aBSPzE1cguVGlZKBnqQL0P_AmDQtnCQEdg5bZ3k0JEe1ATyqkZQ3aIlAOBISk4TXdVE7w4teZjGQaLoPXRBn7ihBxikGAEuTpF4F0ROXH2vnGWi3zeHjerF5lSpHHhmhpTy-crpYnPsVr20tlXGfzC4M7hXsnuhS817ctn7QuRy9Ofv6cllPreyN-vfgo9KBu0fxu8178WSsdkR47efv96GEfgwMpB7iyaSC3tk_EYRw_o1fFoYvy1YHNaPB-kpWYwbhjkxfvsv7EtuVE5YV7TbPsO6hioVE_18wh-92jfPcWj4FwAA__8T2Z7d)
---
A couple of years later, that hospital called one of the rescue partners we support.

Police officers escorted our partner to a small private room in the back, where Lyra was waiting.

"I sat beside her," our partner told me, "and slowly, she began to trust me."

Then the tears came, and the whole story came out.

_But getting her out safely was another matter. _

**Traffickers do not let go of a child easily. Many would rather take a child 's life than let her escape and tell the truth. **

So when Lyra was released, they did not use the front door.

They walked down a long hospital hallway... slipped through the back doors... and into a hidden car.

**That day, Lyra was free.**

And that was only the beginning.

Our partner brought her home, protected her, and raised her - for years.

She kept studying. She graduated. Then she graduated again.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGP3CAQhX8N7m5lDxjWBUWU1Uop7tqUaA4GG50BB7BP-feRd69Jex3Mm_c9Pc3vV_OKYQ1pfsNI2h7BlGpaQe-D_aBSPzE1cguVGlZKBnqQL0P_AmDQtnCQEdg5bZ3k0JEe1ATyqkZQ3aIlAOBISk4TXdVE7w4teZjGQaLoPXRBn7ihBxikGAEuTpF4F0ROXH2vnGWi3zeHjerF5lSpHHhmhpTy-crpYnPsVr20tlXGfzC4M7hXsnuhS817ctn7QuRy9Ofv6cllPreyN-vfgo9KBu0fxu8178WSsdkR47efv96GEfgwMpB7iyaSC3tk_EYRw_o1fFoYvy1YHNaPB-kpWYwbhjkxfvsv7EtuVE5YV7TbPsO6hioVE_18wh-92jfPcWj4FwAA__8T2Z7d)
---
**Friend, today, Lyra is a practicing nurse.**

The little girl who spent her childhood being hurt by others grew up to become a woman who brings healing to others.

Our partner describes this work in three words:

**Rescue. Restore. Raise. **
---
Help Rescue the Next Child Like Lyra
---
Friend, you care about protecting children. Before you trust anyone with that, you deserve to know who they are.

**So here is who we are. **

**We were born from a film that moved millions**. In 2023, Sound of Freedom brought the hidden reality of child trafficking into theaters across America and around the world.

Sound of Freedom Foundation was created to turn that awareness into action.

**We fight trafficking on five fronts** :
---
* **Prevention** : helping impoverished families most at risk, before traffickers can reach their children
* **Intervention** : supporting the agencies and partners who rescue trafficked children
* **Education** : giving parents and children the warning signs
* **Information** : using media to bring trafficking out of the shadows
* **Influence** : pressing governments and leaders for laws that put traffickers behind bars

---
**We stand with proven partners on the front lines.** These include House Parent Project, which has given rescued and vulnerable children a safe home for more than two decades; Safe House Project, which provides emergency services and training in the U.S.; and For Freedom International, which leads investigations and aftercare in Southeast Asia.

**And we have seen the results.** Five little sisters rescued after one stranger made one phone call. A baby recovered from a trafficker's apartment minutes before she could disappear forever.

_And now, Lyra._

Friend, rescue is never just one moment.

It is the hospital room, the back door, the hidden car... and then years of meals, schoolwork, counseling, and people who stay.

**That is what your gift makes possible**. The prophet Isaiah wrote:

"_He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners._ " (Isaiah 61:1)

One hospital visit changed everything. | | | | | | | | God's Children Are Not For Sale | | | | Friend, The call came from a hospital. A teenage girl had been brought in after passing out. The man who brought her in said he had no idea what was wrong. He was her father. The nurses examined her. What they found told them everything. Friend, my name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film Sound of Freedom. That film moved millions of people to ask, "What can I do?" Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to answer that question, by helping stop the sale of God's children. I want to tell you about this girl, because her story shows exactly what it takes to save a child. Her name is not Lyra, but this is her true story. Lyra grew up in a home where NO ONE kept her safe. Her mother let the men she brought home hurt her little girl. Then those men brought their friends. For years, Lyra was abused and trafficked inside her own home. Through all of it, she never stopped going to school. She was a straight-A student who dreamed of a better life. At twelve, she found out where her father lived. She ran to him, believing everything would finally change. It only got worse. Her father began abusing her too. Then he handed her over to other men. A couple of years later, that hospital called one of the rescue partners we support. Police officers escorted our partner to a small private room in the back, where Lyra was waiting. "I sat beside her," our partner told me, "and slowly, she began to trust me." Then the tears came, and the whole story came out. But getting her out safely was another matter. Traffickers do not let go of a child easily. Many would rather take a child 's life than let her escape and tell the truth. So when Lyra was released, they did not use the front door. They walked down a long hospital hallway... slipped through the back doors... and into a hidden car. That day, Lyra was free. And that was only the beginning. Our partner brought her home, protected her, and raised her - for years. She kept studying. She graduated. Then she graduated again. Friend, today, Lyra is a practicing nurse. The little girl who spent her childhood being hurt by others grew up to become a woman who brings healing to others. Our partner describes this work in three words: Rescue. Restore. Raise. Help Rescue the Next Child Like Lyra Friend, you care about protecting children. Before you trust anyone with that, you deserve to know who they are. So here is who we are. We were born from a film that moved millions. In 2023, Sound of Freedom brought the hidden reality of child trafficking into theaters across America and around the world. Sound of Freedom Foundation was created to turn that awareness into action. We fight trafficking on five fronts : Prevention : helping impoverished families most at risk, before traffickers can reach their children Intervention : supporting the agencies and partners who rescue trafficked children Education : giving parents and children the warning signs Information : using media to bring trafficking out of the shadows Influence : pressing governments and leaders for laws that put traffickers behind bars We stand with proven partners on the front lines. These include House Parent Project, which has given rescued and vulnerable children a safe home for more than two decades; Safe House Project, which provides emergency services and training in the U.S.; and For Freedom International, which leads investigations and aftercare in Southeast Asia. And we have seen the results. Five little sisters rescued after one stranger made one phone call. A baby recovered from a trafficker's apartment minutes before she could disappear forever. And now, Lyra. Friend, rescue is never just one moment. It is the hospital room, the back door, the hidden car... and then years of meals, schoolwork, counseling, and people who stay. That is what your gift makes possible. The prophet Isaiah wrote: "He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners. " (Isaiah 61:1) Tonight, somewhere, another girl is in a place that should be safe... and isn't. Someone needs to get her out. Someone needs to stay. Yes, I'll Help Rescue the Next Child Like Lyra The men who hurt Lyra wanted her silent. Today, she has a voice, a calling, and a future. I would be honored to have you stand with us. name: Mai Vang
subject: I don’t have the luxury of waiting
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
It’s been an unspoken rule that you don't do what I’m doing.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Mai Vang.
Election Day is less than two weeks away, and early voting is well underway here in CA-07.
**Recent polls show us ahead of incumbent Rep. Doris Matsui. We know we have the momentum, but polls don’t decide elections, Peter — _voters do._**
**[Can you rush any amount to my campaign and Justice Democrats right now to help secure our victory on November 3rd?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261022-mv.9n7HUa&refcode=em20261022-38377&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=38377%2E1203867%2EKSnFet)**
Unlike my opponent, we didn’t build our movement by taking corporate PAC cash or bowing to powerful lobbies. We built it by relying entirely on grassroots supporters chipping in what they can — supporters who believe leaders must answer to the people, not megadonors bankrolling their campaigns.
I don’t take running against an incumbent with a decades-long dynasty lightly, Peter. I _always_ knew this would be an uphill battle. It’s been an unspoken rule by local electeds that you don’t do what I’m doing — you don’t take on an incumbent, and you sit on the sidelines and wait your turn.
**I don’t have the luxury of waiting when our democracy is under attack, our loved ones are being separated by ICE, and billionaires are making the lives of working families unlivable.**
Establishment politicians like Matsui have created the conditions we face today by selling out to the _exact_ corporations making everyday lives worse. We live in the richest state in the richest country in the world, yet we can’t provide for our people — forcing them to decide between putting food on the table or delaying their own healthcare.
We need people in power who understand the struggles of working people. If we don’t elect bold, courageous leaders who are willing to hold Trump and the establishment accountable, we’re going to end up right back where we started.
**I’m ready to be that leader for Sacramento, but I need your help to make sure I get there.[Pitch in $10 to my campaign and Justice Democrats today to help us cross the finish line and win.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261022-mv.9n7HUa&refcode=em20261022-38377&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=3&akid=38377%2E1203867%2EKSnFet)**
**[Contribute $10](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261022-mv.9n7HUa&refcode=em20261022-38377&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=22&akid=38377%2E1203867%2EKSnFet)**
Thank you,
Mai Vang

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20261022-38377-footer&t=23&refcode2=38377_1203867_KSnFet&akid=38377%2E1203867%2EKSnFet)**

name: Swing Left
subject: Dr. Amy Acton needs our help in Ohio
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
A Republican billionaire just launched a nasty attack ad against Dr. Amy Acton, the Democratic nominee for Ohio governor.
#
Hi there,
Yesterday, Vivek Ramaswamy confirmed that a horrible attack ad released earlier this week against Dr. Amy Acton, the Democratic nominee for governor of Ohio, came from his campaign. It’s one of the most vile attack ads we’ve ever seen–full of false accusations and personal attacks, delivered by Dr. Acton’s estranged, abusive mother.
**It’s a new low.**
At the start of this race, the Ohio Republican Party quickly lined up behind Vivek Ramaswamy, backed by both Donald Trump and JD Vance, and funded by more than $5 million from Elon Musk.
They expected an easy win in this former swing state where Democrats have lost ground the last few elections, but they’re in trouble. Recent polls show Dr. Acton up by as much as 8 points, a shift from earlier in the campaign when Ramaswamy consistently polled ahead. So instead of campaigning with dignity, the Ramaswamy campaign has resorted to personal and ugly attacks.
They’re running scared—and for good reason. While Ramaswamy is weighed down by Trump’s historically low approval ratings, Dr. Acton is benefiting from a strong campaign and a united Democratic ticket, including Sherrod Brown’s race for U.S. Senate, which is expected to help drive massive turnout in the state.
Right now, Ohio Republicans hold the governor’s seat and both state legislatures—a full trifecta—and have used it aggressively to hold on to power through redistricting and election law changes. **If Dr. Acton wins her race and flips the governor's mansion, she would break that trifecta and give Democrats a vital veto in the state.**
But with so much money pouring into the state to fund last-minute attack ads like the one from the Ramaswamy campaign this week, Dr. Acton needs the resources to set the record straight and reach every single voter before Election Day.
[**That’s why we’re asking you to donate $25, or any amount you can, to the Ohio Win In The States Fund today.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=sl-states-oh-2026.IZ8_z3&amount=25&%3Butm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=states-2026&%3Butm_content=20261022-1&%3Brefcode=ak_em_states-2026_20261022-1&t=2&akid=3242%2E1562180%2E5Xiiv-)

Your donation will make sure Dr. Acton and Ohio Senate and House Democrats have the resources they need to win less than two weeks from today. Friend,

After Ilhan Omar’s home was raided as part of an ongoing immigration investigation, she tried to play the victim card and called it all a hoax.

When that didn’t work, she called up her leftist buddy, Barack Obama, to tag in and defend her.

[](http://links.contact.tomcotton.com/u/click?_t=5c7e379ccd6b459ba3c20de95bf89a24&_m=d5f3272b3e6e45eb9a85f7d88a693c88&_e=r2NnrTdwPJyFhIdu-a2EpP4Cokpsy7VgQBfIY4lh3GgbQ93l1QMhUVWn5rLe_m1He8RARjRxPU6IHjQJDlo25NrzuZTOyiaiww6axvFRPjrS381S5hcmHSISzwc_ZeZSnjdXuXgC6WBQmkzJLhrfhOPgS74NQZJPVAlYAK1QAND7Mt3loqlL843ne2aEZKmkTqtWe6J1R4d4jNI2dfYLF-ozf-7wsL8ADf__Watdv_G-7pFDTH8SICdsNAmwlP-s8-ayZpijsokDnyeTbRYalfWzsF70FH-0FUMoV1uUN1g1GVsUTapJ-8xREcsnKsXHCUVPxJ4APj3F50Rpo3yzkEgP6cSPoff-fj9aR_1vfVUoV2e800042ol3RMq57e7RRwP_LJlkl7oMuFq86U_2eruw7OydXLCG4dISYce9gHP0LLZwNXbuzIWTUCmrU6kPDfvnGRoBS4-C1xWf7BMTfIJA-P3PwzGXBAI7kupbRqCC5TE-VqQst98-zk356jAe)
_Frankly, I find it ironic._

I find it ironic that she calls the claims against her a hoax, and then rushes to the biggest hoax-pusher America has ever seen.

**Let’s not forget:** The Obama-started Russiagate hoax was exactly that: a hoax.

Barack Obama weaponized the federal government like no president ever has.

_And this is who Ilhan Omar runs to for help?_

| | | We need your help in Florida, Peter, Just a few months ago, Angie Nixon stunned the establishment by winning her Senate primary in Florida by **more than 150,000 votes, despite being outspent 16 to 1.** This landslide was further proof that organized people and the fearless candidates they support can take on organized money. Now, Angie — a union organizer, former Bernie staffer, and single mother of five — is taking on Ashley Moody, who recently helped divert $10 million that was meant to provide Medicaid to sick Florida children into the pockets of political slush funds instead.1 **We’re once again going up against some of the biggest crooks in politics. And the latest polls show us just four points down.** 2 **[This is the kind of gap we can close by knocking on doors and talking to voters, but only with your help. So if you can, split a donation right now between Angie Nixon’s campaign and WFP, and help us elect a true working class champion to the Senate.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9yPQO_cFK-E34hhpZ3I61FReNwXNDLvnjoetwSvdfFYZ9R8oqaeHa68Vv_wft7U1wmHcR2F_KpKUzBrap4Jx5Gzjcq5scRI1-nLSAGMvhBJ1g3MRUu1Y_RBE8SEWdtSI9hgjyV2wgFkI4sZYURd7-7Cxp2DpliFqWsd8HM6MVKuw2uvQDvEWz56-Uy0V37bxpwCJUt7l1WC0F3Bfusj9wAVpo_GVtDN8S4GM4G0oukHH6EHYzMk4a2eMniWaNT9ah3-YCEae_KmhS19-0Z0bGxP9cLca_al9ds3wKUaSmMcOON-VxyHkQRWgqgRQJMMq6i1R-IserF9xBXac1u7oFDH7__AZ7tiIdSfKa5QBB0eo/4v3/A4eyBcDGSN-bKl_GEmhqBw/h0/h001.v5g95eZjmZyx6hGtRGaALqLhoFGgZNU4noGjArpaXVU)** **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9yPQO_cFK-E34hhpZ3I61FReNwXNDLvnjoetwSvdfFYZjGWmfCtGw08RUl56zZG0RfE548Bapc7NNtnEae1TonBWhi4YXzpXexP4OrvpQ3OrbZnrZYG45nvzPfQROxIbP1TCpBwgo01Ent7h2_dOAJ7EErhmySSqn81OoOCRCdSv5mCnym0uO4eu2visxy0MNqEjvjnX4aiDypcYkt17curt5-QABNdY4pYXfcP-evATQHP6xwHwWGqejmAab8gqrfdj431QGUQG9H4DfWGDsvWmLb14NWh4fbXRRj8VM7qdbRuCIBuRtLKiw50-HRArganPfyyzUd_jv2LsPBurs8AbhjfJqDrvbo79zIkAf6RO0IyxzcBmHJEWHzo15l3Nk/4v3/A4eyBcDGSN-bKl_GEmhqBw/h1/h001.hRVRoBMUfYNcef2j_E09N7bpQphq8n3L30L5S7XJNko)** Angie Nixon understands, like we do, that health care is a human right. This landslide was further proof that organized people and the fearless candidates they support can take on organized money. Now, Angie — a union organizer, former Bernie staffer, and single mother of five — is taking on Ashley Moody, who recently helped divert $10 million that was meant to provide Medicaid to sick Florida children into the pockets of political slush funds instead.1 We’re once again going up against some of the biggest crooks in politics. And the latest polls show us just four points down. 2 Angie Nixon understands, like we do, that health care is a human right. That full-time jobs should afford everyone the chance to live a life of dignity. That billionaires need to pay their fair share. And that signing away blank checks to defense contractors and AI data centers is a disaster for working families. Her opponent could not be more different if she tried. Ashley Moody supported Trump’s “Big Beautiful Bill,” which is throwing hundreds of thousands of her own constituents off their health care. She has voted against ending arms deals to Israel every single time. # The threats will keep coming. So will the reporting.
### You can't threaten this newsroom into silence. A Senate candidate's lawyers just found that out.
| | | [Drop Site News](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
| Oct 22
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
Last week, attorneys for Mike Rogers, the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Michigan, and his wife, Kristi Rogers, sent Drop Site News a letter demanding that we retract our recent investigation, and threatening litigation if we didn't. They gave us five days.
The five days came and went. We didn't retract our story. Instead, we published a follow-up.
Our original investigation looked into contracts won by the security firm Aegis Defense Services while Kristi Rogers was serving as the head of its American subsidiary, including while Rogers was serving as chairman of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence. We stand by our reporting and will defend it if necessary.
We refuse to be intimidated. This newsroom belongs to the readers who fund it, and we're asking those readers to step up right now.
The people sending these letters are betting that readers like you won't show up. Let's prove them wrong. For less than $0.25 a day, you become part of the community that makes this newsroom impossible to intimidate, impossible to exhaust, and impossible to silence.
**[Upgrade to a paid subscription today, and for the next 48 hours, it's 20% off.](https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc291-09d5-43ff-852a-1ae86bf8101f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[UPGRADE TODAY - 20% OFF](https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc291-09d5-43ff-852a-1ae86bf8101f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**They Don 't Send Letters to Newsrooms That Don't Matter**
A letter like this is designed to work quietly. The newsroom pulls the piece, or softens it, or just thinks twice before publishing the next one. Nobody ever hears about it, and the story goes away.
That's not what happened here. Our reporting is still up. Our follow-up lays out exactly what the letter objects to, including claims our original story never made. And the attempt to make this story disappear has only put more attention on it.
This isn't the first time. A top BBC editor sued over our reporting on the BBC's coverage of Gaza. That case is still ongoing, and we've won a major procedural victory. The White House has denounced our reporting. Governments have banned us. Coordinated campaigns have called for federal investigations into our correspondents.
That is not the profile of a newsroom that powerful people ignore. **That is the profile of a newsroom that worries them.** That is where you come in. Every reader who upgrades is making a direct statement: threats like this don't work.
[You can make that statement right now. Can you support our work by becoming a paid subscriber today?](https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc291-09d5-43ff-852a-1ae86bf8101f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[SUPPORT DROP SITE - 20% OFF](https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc291-09d5-43ff-852a-1ae86bf8101f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Why Reader-Funded Matters Right Now**
Drop Site was built on a simple premise: journalism that answers to no one but our readers. No corporate owners. No billionaire backers deciding which stories are safe to publish. No political parties pulling strings.
That independence is exactly why we could publish this investigation, and exactly why we didn't back down when the letter arrived. It's also why the people threatening us think we're vulnerable. We don't have a corporate parent to absorb the legal bills. What we have is hundreds of thousands of readers who refuse to let this reporting disappear.
The legal threats will keep coming as long as we keep doing work that matters. The only question is whether this newsroom has the reader base to absorb every punch and keep publishing. Every paid subscriber makes Drop Site harder to intimidate. Every upgrade from free to paid is a direct investment in our ability to keep reporting on the powerful, no matter who sends the next letter.
**[For the next 48 hours, we're offering 20% off an annual subscription. That's less than $0.25 a day to fund the reporting a Senate candidate's lawyers wanted gone.](https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc291-09d5-43ff-852a-1ae86bf8101f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The people sending these letters have high-priced law firms, political operations and friends in power. The only advantage we have is you.
When lawyers demand we retract our reporting, we stand by it and keep digging. When powerful people try to make a story disappear, we publish more. When our journalism comes under attack, our readers have our backs. Become one of them today.
[UPGRADE NOW - SUPPORT OUR WORK](https://substack.com/redirect/b6abc291-09d5-43ff-852a-1ae86bf8101f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
They sent us a letter. We answered with more reporting. Now let's answer it with thousands more paid subscribers.
\- The Drop Site Team
_P.S. If a paid subscription isn 't possible right now, that's okay. Keep reading, keep sharing. But if you've been on the fence, this is the moment. And if you'd rather not have a recurring subscription, please consider a [tax-deductible donation to our legal defense fund instead.](https://substack.com/redirect/e71ba776-3c51-4985-89eb-c3f4826c7194?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
[DEFEND DROP SITE - DONATE TODAY](https://substack.com/redirect/e71ba776-3c51-4985-89eb-c3f4826c7194?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Peter — it's Amy.
My decision to email you today wasn't an easy one — but I don't want to wake up on November 4 wondering if one more email could have tipped the scales.
Because that's how close this race is, Peter.
**Experts have said our race for governor is one of the most competitive in the entire country.**
Right now, we're facing a significant budget gap — and it means we're at risk of having to pull the plug on some of our TV ads, just 13 days before the election...
**My finance team pulled the numbers, and if everyone reading this email chipped in $8 or more — we'd be able to keep our ads on air.**

name: Public Citizen
subject: No Kings was undermined by Big Tech
body:
No Kings was back in force this past weekend. With over 3,000 events nationwide, _No Kings: Vote Early_ was the largest day of voter activation in American history.

**But No Kings’ reach was undermined by the giant tech company owned by Facebook founder (and apparent Trump convert) Mark Zuckerberg.

Public Citizen just launched an investigation under the Freedom of Information Act to expose this potential interference in our democracy by Big Tech.**

Here’s what you need to know:

* At approximately 1:30 p.m. EDT Saturday, the official No Kings page on Instagram was taken down — even as literally thousands of events were underway or about to begin all across America.

* The page was down for over 90 minutes, and organizers were locked out of the account for over four hours.

* This was done by Meta, the $1.8 trillion Big Tech behemoth that owns Instagram, Facebook, and other social media platforms.

* Meta’s CEO is Mark Zuckerberg, who is currently the sixth richest person on the planet* and who has, to put it mildly, been quite cozy with the regime since Donald Trump returned to power.

* Meta has gone through a variety of excuses — including blaming the incident on a confused AI model. (Yet Meta and other Big Tech giants keep pumping out ever more powerful “artificial intelligence” systems that they themselves do not understand and cannot control.)

The No Kings Coalition — which Public Citizen helps lead — has written a letter demanding answers from Zuckerberg.

**Public Citizen is taking another step. We just launched an investigation under the Freedom of Information Act to demand any and all communications about this incident between Meta and Trump’s Department of Homeland Security.**

Here’s what one of us (Lisa) told the national media:

“Meta’s discordant response and lack of transparency are unacceptable. Our investigation into the communications between the administration and Meta, coupled with our No Kings Coalition letter demanding answers, are both designed to get to the bottom of these cagey rationales. The public deserves to understand why these actions occurred.”

**Investigating and exposing corporate meddling in our democracy is just one part of the work Public Citizen has been doing since Trump returned to power. That includes 54 lawsuits (so far) against the administration and numerous investigations under the Freedom of Information Act.**

**[If you can, please donate today to support Public Citizen as we continue standing up to the Trump regime.](https://donate.citizen.org/page/95108/donate/1)**

**[Anything you can chip in — $5 or $25, $50 or $100, $500 or even more — will make a difference right now.](https://donate.citizen.org/page/95108/donate/1)**

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://donate.citizen.org/page/95108/donate/1)**
**[Or join our popular Monthly Giving program (if you haven’t already) to help make sure we have the ongoing financial resources to fight Trump day after day after day.](https://donate.citizen.org/page/61257/donate/1)**

If you’ve donated to Public Citizen before, thank you. If a donation is not right, we understand. Either way, thank you for being part of Public Citizen.

For democracy,

\- Lisa Gilbert & Robert Weissman, Co-Presidents of Public Citizen

*That’s according to Forbes’ _Real-Time Billionaires_ list. We’ve said it before and we’ll say it again: If there are so many billionaires whose fortunes are increasing so rapidly that there’s a “need” to track their wealth in real time, our priorities as a society may be out of whack.

Public Citizen | 1600 20th Street NW | Washington DC 20009 | [Unsubscribe](https://act.citizen.org/page/email/subscribe?campaignpageurl=https%3A%2F%2Fact.citizen.org%2Fpage%2F58828%2Fsubscriptions%2F1%3Fea.broadcast.id%3D612664&ea.campaigner.email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC)

A note from Senator Ashley Moody |

Friend,
I'm going to be honest with you, because I don't know any other way to say this.
My heart breaks for France right now. City halls burning to the ground. More than 600 police officers injured in a single day. Rioters tearing the French flag off the monument to their own Republic – and raising a Palestinian flag in its place, while others march under the hammer and sickle.
Communists and radical Islamists, side by side in the streets. **That 's not a coincidence. That's an alliance.** And it has eyes on more than Europe.
This radical movement is working to infiltrate our own country – and it's counting on patriots like you not realizing it until it's too late.
It is the honor of my life to serve as Florida's U.S. Senator. My state is full of people who already know how this story ends. Families who fled Castro with nothing but the clothes on their backs. Venezuelans who watched their country get looted by socialists in a single generation. Nicaraguans who escaped Ortega. They came here because America was the one place it couldn't happen.
Here, that movement has a fellow traveler on the ballot, and her name is **Angie Nixon.**
She runs a bookstore called "Cafe Resistance." On its wall hang portraits of convicted cop killers – including Assata Shakur, who murdered a New Jersey state trooper and fled to Castro's Cuba. When she was confronted about it, she said she stands by "everything in this bookstore."
She closes her speeches with a line from the Communist Manifesto – "We have nothing to lose but our chains" – and she took that chant to a CAIR gala. She was one of just 7 votes against teaching students the history of communism. She signed the pledge to abolish ICE. She voted against tougher penalties for people who assault police officers.
And she just raised $7 million to take Florida's U.S. Senate seat – more than we raised in the same three months. And Bernie Sanders just pointed his $23 million war chest at this race and came to Florida himself to campaign for her and turn out the vote.
This is a special election – the biggest Senate race in the country this year – and some new polls say it's within the margin of error. If she wins, she becomes **the first dues-paying member of the Democratic Socialists of America in the U.S. Senate.**

name: Caitlin Cattelino
subject: Webinar Invitation: What’s the permitting bill's impact on endangered species?
body:
Join Defenders to learn more about a dangerous Senate bill threatening endangered wildlife and how you can help defeat it!

Join Defenders to learn more about a dangerous Senate bill threatening endangered wildlife and how you can help defeat it!
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6194098/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6194099/38SyG9Xl)

Dear Defender,

In the remaining months of the 119th Congress, the Senate is poised to vote on one of the worst attacks we’ve seen on threatened and endangered wildlife, the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (S. 5653). If passed, this bill would make vast and dangerous changes to the Endangered Species Act, our country’s strongest tool for preventing extinction.

On Thursday, October 29, join Defenders for a Zoom webinar to learn more about the concerning ESA provisions in S. 5653 and take action to urge your Senator to oppose this bill!

(https://support.defenders.org/s/6194100/38SyG9Xl)

RSVP to receive your zoom link! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6194101/38SyG9Xl)

WHAT: Wildlife Defenders Webinar –

Oppose the Senate permitting bill

WHEN: Thursday, October 29

TIME: 1:00pm ET / 12:00pm CT /

11:00am MT / 10:00am PT

WHERE: Live via Zoom

RSVP here to receive your zoom link! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6194102/38SyG9Xl)

We agree that America needs affordable energy, a modern electric grid, more housing and infrastructure capable of meeting the demands of a growing economy. However, we do not need to, nor should we, sacrifice our country’s wildlife and natural heritage to do so. There is clear evidence that the ESA is not the obstacle to development that opponents claim it is. And S. 5653 would weaken fundamental wildlife protections without addressing the problems that actually slow development.

We want to connect with wildlife advocates who support protecting our cherished wildlife, not gutting vital conservation laws, like the ESA, in the name of infrastructure development.

RSVP to save your spot at our webinar! (https://support.defenders.org/s/6194103/38SyG9Xl)

We expect this bill to come to the Senate floor shortly after the November 3 elections. Now is the time to raise our voices and tell our Senators to vote NO on S. 5653. We can build the future America needs without dismantling our commitment to the wildlife and natural heritage we share.

I hope to see you next week!

Caitlin Cattelino

Director of National Outreach

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

Case File No DRT-ED-RANGE · Special File · The Long-Range War
Ukraine Paused Its Refinery Strikes for Three Days. Then It Hit Russia Again, Hundreds of Miles Behind the Front.
After a brief “energy ceasefire,” Ukraine resumed long-range drone strikes on Russian refineries this month, including one that supplies Moscow. It plans more than 800 deep strikes this year. The targets get the headlines. How a country without a long-range air force keeps hitting them is the more interesting story.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Most wars are fought along a front line. This one is increasingly fought hundreds of miles behind it. Refineries, fuel depots, air bases and air-defense sites deep inside Russia are now regular targets, and the strikes keep landing, night after night.
The evidence board
| | What Happened This Month
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the pause.** President Zelensky said Ukraine stopped hitting Russian refineries for three days to honor President Trump’s proposed “energy ceasefire,” then resumed because Russia kept striking Ukraine’s power grid. “The block is out. We’re done,” he told the Financial Times.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the targets.** Overnight before October 15, Ukrainian drones set fire to the Ryazan refinery, which supplies fuel to Moscow and accounts for about 5% of Russia’s refining capacity. It was the fourth attack there since May. On October 18, a refinery near Saint Petersburg was set ablaze.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the scale.** According to The Economist, Ukraine is planning more than 800 deep strikes in 2026, up from 685 in 2025.
| OUR THEORY
---
Hitting a single refinery unit hundreds of miles away, through jamming and air defenses, isn’t about firepower. It’s about navigation, targeting and coordination. That’s a technology problem, and some of the solutions come from companies most investors have never heard of.
Connected file
| | Everything Runs on Chips Now
---|---
Modern drones, missiles, phones and PCs all depend on the same thing: specialized chips built on a handful of core designs. Demand is surging on several fronts at once. Microsoft ended support for Windows 10 in October 2025, pushing businesses and households to upgrade hardware, while militaries race to add AI to their systems.
Some analysts say one company quietly collects a fee on a huge share of those chips.
| | Sponsored by Behind the Markets
---
[The largest forced hardware upgrade in history is underway.](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=c98b3ad6e6e24679b66e4d297e8836b4&_e=n9GiUoSqyWnYNHRD1o2YBKYosxtPfYp1MBA1ytWR7EWiHyBGYbnPmaxzxBgPmbznxD3FiNaUSXqkDIgZqwaH0yDS4u1g3ZUAj9Hbb9JYIRTX1Hc9gdzV3bIpM22YJw5PBULwjA3V42Oc_lM-ipPF6_087nvZMg_il12H9Jfv8e1xdESKEAiwA2v7LpAVrbmUf-I6bZu688FxZjvMqvDh05OJoktcMO1ZhY9or8EDOxDsBoa0UTZ-doGaZg51aQGFt9bTskcx0NQAWDsyTgCJYtM1mpUzCsB2iMPzSruVYCvE-Xxwn_vjaIymeS1d82XLJI5oonW8ZEC8YzHBolWzmBp0L584Vz96EwbKgShsffFeDnZPy4OIL6GQz0o5X7LU0wogigNs8su43wbjIM53NraSxyl2VV12_pIXsbj0AFlwbxS2vcFgLMek_lDRkQRv_B7sAgE0UUnbzwo3hf2bipLxsI-Mm2VSVAGjuhOD7fApmNafriAhNfWlVsWoddNPtVNR6VliDOMf4zO3ARHul516yIP1oFNrbbRI0gTHJNY%3D)
Every new device requires a specific chip architecture.
And one company — one — holds the legally binding patents on every blueprint.
They don’t build a single chip. They just collect the toll. On every one.

Why it matters to you
| | Why This Is an Investment Story
---|---
| → | **Precision is the new firepower.** Every military watching Ukraine wants the same capabilities.
---|---
| → | **Suppliers are often small.** Specialized guidance and sensing technology rarely comes from the biggest defense names.
---|---
| → | **Demand is spreading.** NATO countries are rebuilding stockpiles and buying these tools.
---|---
| Classification Pattern confirmed
---
The strikes keep working, month after month. The technology behind that success, and the companies that make it, may matter more to investors than any single target.
Connected file
| | Energy Is the Battlefield
---|---
This war has turned energy into a target on both sides: Russia hits Ukraine’s power grid, Ukraine hits Russia’s refineries. Even in peacetime, grids can come close to the edge. On Christmas Eve 2022, New England’s grid operator ran short of reserves for about two and a half hours after several plants failed in the cold, and real-time power prices averaged over $2,000 per megawatt-hour.
One veteran analyst believes the next crisis could hit much closer to home.

Then It Hit Russia Again, Hundreds of Miles Behind the Front. After a brief “energy ceasefire,” Ukraine resumed long-range drone strikes on Russian refineries this month, including one that supplies Moscow. It plans more than 800 deep strikes this year. The targets get the headlines. How a country without a long-range air force keeps hitting them is the more interesting story. | | | Fellow Conservative, I'm not on the ballot this year. You'd never know it from my calendar. Friday, I gave the keynote at the Alaska Republican Party event in Anchorage to support my friend and colleague, Senator Dan Sullivan. Saturday, Dan Sullivan and I held **three get-out-the-vote rallies in a single day.** Before that, I was home in Texas, rallying with Ken Paxton in San Antonio and across the state. This year I've also campaigned for conservatives in Georgia, Iowa, Nebraska, and South Carolina. _And I 'm not done._ North Carolina for Michael Whatley is next.Why am I doing this? Because right now, _there are 8 to 10 Senate races within the margin of error. _
---
[](https://trk.email.tedcruz._4l5L0g)
---
_**_And Chuck Schumer only needs 4 seats to take back the Senate majority._**_
---
[ **HOLD THE LINE -> KEEP THE SENATE RED** ](https://trk.email.tedcruz._hS7_VdyP4tVhw)
---
That's it. Four. And he's coming after seats that used to be untouchable. _This is exactly who Schumer is counting on ..._ **In Texas, James Talarico** is WRONG for our state. His agenda is a direct threat to Texas energy, Texas ranchers, God-fearing Texans, and a secure border. **In Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed.** A DSA-backed radical Muslim who would be one of the most dangerous Anti-American Senators in the country. **In Alaska, Mary Peltola.** Is an unhinged radical who is running hard to take out one of the best conservatives in the Senate. _I told the crowd in Alaska this is one of the most important Senate races in the whole country_. The truth is, **so is Texas. So is Michigan. So are all of them.** **The polling in Texas, a state Democrats haven 't won a Senate race in since 1988, shows the race is tied.** **If they can flip Texas, no red state is safe.** Here's the problem, Fellow Conservative. _I can 't be in every state at once. But you can help me._ **Please rush $25 right now to help hold the line and keep the Senate red.** Your gift goes straight to the races that decide the majority.
---
[ **HOLD THE LINE -> KEEP THE SENATE RED** ](https://trk.email.tedcruz.-anFYoFIdDN9Wt6kK6dzdg)
---
I'll keep putting the pedal to the metal and do my part. _But I need you with me in this.

_ Let's win this, Fellow Conservative. For America's Future,

Ted Cruz

And he's coming after seats that used to be untouchable. This is exactly who Schumer is counting on ... In Texas, James Talarico is WRONG for our state. His agenda is a direct threat to Texas energy, Texas ranchers, God-fearing Texans, and a secure border. In Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed. A DSA-backed radical Muslim who would be one of the most dangerous Anti-American Senators in the country. In Alaska, Mary Peltola. Is an unhinged radical who is running hard to take out one of the best conservatives in the Senate. I told the crowd in Alaska this is one of the most important Senate races in the whole country. The truth is, so is Texas. So is Michigan. So are all of them. The polling in Texas, a state Democrats haven 't won a Senate race in since 1988, shows the race is tied. If they can flip Texas, no red state is safe. Here's the problem, Fellow Conservative. I can 't be in every state at once. But you can help me. **Patriot, it’s John James. **
We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. _I promise I will not waste your time._
I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted.
I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, _**I would live it.**_
[**Eventually, this led me to apply to West Point, and my decision to serve my country would make me the man I am today.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=371bbc41381042568a572b2e7d5e9812&_e=z-lF4svnW0gsrxhVAyvj0AuPlfuBpvVIsObQQPU_VHHOKyyrWSUiAMBr1oEe-kR8KWfThxwZYSosF78q4q_dai2GXw61ME2HE436k5gFghSkE2qPegbpV_oXoIBXyVzTQmkNIoA2DIDsdK6KsorVLkbfnPCEvfXh67HAuSe_nxRZzmkhdgmvIR3XbyoEl2ybrCYNuFYSiaBfVGQwzCNNuHop1iCOU32RfhXrsDKiAqCZtkSwFylBEv8rzg-c_jATWfsS5FQwt21LfYH3-VPMqxDb8BKiqRoiRGGEy2SEv9nkllkQ_dKm-QMtaosa4Ht_4TZUIRxMWMqgOIkita5vTrkMQ1QBy6TZTu6dPDK8zWytMvfe2r-64bjOdBMhMmusx1Zthahk6-RWwYtOIS4UBEmCvcM0xbp2exo5uZtxI50BfTZpWoePse8v4MHVoMUhfb_lodZM8-1Z0ipSJ2ckqWEDgb2p0G6CiuuRRqEK5vWOFqr8fcmyF58zK49c-JdzdgqA05foIxgzd75VHc26F2_AEFGYSPn6ZywKmu2a875_-FWs3WtnyGp-M30RGfbRfbB7xw8f8W1aMggQtFpfFd4wBj6zXTtk6YLU9_n_6SrfpoX8_Ch5FC6rpUFr3nYR2YU3pIL6gxp5RBnaKdGkG_NWQiDiXhtnUpMdJTAdIzkoQ11Ka1Sy_ZM2lywBBMhORGF7k-CQcssrSYYHc2QtDeqVl9efP0QX25PDTSAuDd1NQgKL_fNTRZck4i6VTyzm)

Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army.
During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. **Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. **
**I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and _I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud._**

After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, **_I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. _**
I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician...
[**But there comes a point in your life when you stop looking at the issues surrounding you and start thinking about what you can do to fix them.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=371bbc41381042568a572b2e7d5e9812&_e=z-lF4svnW0gsrxhVAyvj0AuPlfuBpvVIsObQQPU_VHHOKyyrWSUiAMBr1oEe-kR8KWfThxwZYSosF78q4q_dai2GXw61ME2HE436k5gFghSkE2qPegbpV_oXoIBXyVzTQmkNIoA2DIDsdK6KsorVLkbfnPCEvfXh67HAuSe_nxRZzmkhdgmvIR3XbyoEl2ybrCYNuFYSiaBfVGQwzCNNuHop1iCOU32RfhXrsDKiAqCZtkSwFylBEv8rzg-c_jATWfsS5FQwt21LfYH3-VPMq2i1ym9aUq2KRUOp8B7G613mxdBM0pLw1FGGheqj5uGarmvFfi25NuPw649ExclFLA6eOU9zAMWoqUDzt5Fds1l7pcd2Q42oG_8y68BwzGFF-Hn8ln1djeK9Sss3BNK3OBkzHbDAbcxGPyCz1c_NjkURNcWUlCGMZoqADM7yKHwkEhswamjRtMtskv_hqqYAXNenWpVBmNpso0sJhdX54k50Oi9fzRaCnD3WA4Na8itZ8wfOmH2zcwNKMub1V0PCktpDEMw2Uasdh6ayQ8tU4uP6He4jc0PUQJPKoV15KuY5c1WSpuwuUjxvwDmuXqIqcntYl1Jn-E8xt9ur5ODuINdOG6rzLN_3Es_0LwY3X0YHgqHZG-XRIPe-_zPZy8_-n7ADxdMnppaNWAE33X9aUt0lvUIMrMWw7H1u19uV-tS6FqgNG1_-ZrMSJpMqSHP51-RMKUTnp4fV7G3F_SyuH0Ei3niyw-3usmS-Ohftd5Ci)

I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. **I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents.** Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, _I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024.__ _ **Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate.** My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, __but they’re not my #1 reason why...__

clean_body: Will you have my back on November 3rd?| | | | | Patriot, it’s John James. We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate.
