subject: As ballots arrive, I want to say… THANK YOU
body:
Good afternoon,
With ballots beginning to arrive and Election Day approaching, I wanted
to take a moment to say thank you. When I started this campaign, I knew
running for Congress as a young firefighter and paramedic wasn’t going
to be easy. But I also knew the conversations happening in our
communities deserved to be heard in Washington.
Over the past several months, I’ve had the opportunity to speak with
people across Utah’s 3rd Congressional District. I’ve heard the concerns
of young families wondering if they’ll ever be able to afford a home,
working people watching the cost of groceries and gas climb, small
business owners trying to keep their doors open, and rural communities
fighting to protect their water, land, and way of life.
These aren’t just talking points. They’re real challenges affecting our
neighbors, our families, and our future. I believe we need a government
that takes responsibility for how it spends our money, makes it easier
for Americans to work and build something of their own, and remembers
that the people closest to a problem are often best equipped to solve
it.
Most importantly, I believe public service should be about serving
people, not building a political career. That’s what this campaign has
been about from the beginning, and it’s only possible because of people
like you who have taken the time to listen, share our message, and help
us reach more people.
As you receive and fill out your ballot, I have one simple request!
Please talk to your friends, family, and neighbors about this campaign!
Tell them why you got involved and share the issues that matter most to
you and the kind of representation you want to see in Washington. If

clean_body: Good afternoon, With ballots beginning to arrive and Election Day approaching, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you. When I started this campaign, I knew running for Congress as a young firefighter and paramedic wasn’t going to be easy. But I also knew the conversations happening in our communities deserved to be heard in Washington. Over the past several months, I’ve had the opportunity to speak with people across Utah’s 3rd Congressional District. I’ve heard the concerns of young families wondering if they’ll ever be able to afford a home, working people watching the cost of groceries and gas climb, small business owners trying to keep their doors open, and rural communities fighting to protect their water, land, and way of life. These aren’t just talking points. They’re real challenges affecting our neighbors, our families, and our future. I believe we need a government that takes responsibility for how it spends our money, makes it easier for Americans to work and build something of their own, and remembers that the people closest to a problem are often best equipped to solve it. Most importantly, I believe public service should be about serving people, not building a political career. That’s what this campaign has been about from the beginning, and it’s only possible because of people like you who have taken the time to listen, share our message, and help us reach more people. # [Musk says a SpaceX-Tesla merger is a good idea](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Elon Musk said on SpaceX's earnings call that combining the companies **[would be a good idea,](https://substack.com/redirect/9c10b721-7e81-4518-b3a6-ccf1d722e170?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as both boards formed independent special committees to explore a potential deal that could create a multitrillion-dollar entity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Committees formed for talks:** Both SpaceX and Tesla's special committees of independent directors are to consider a merger, with Musk recusing himself as a conflicted party who cannot join the discussions.
* **Synergies on superintelligence:** Musk pointed to gains from cooperating on superintelligence software, chip design, the Terafab, robotics, and mass-to-orbit capabilities with the Starmind constellation.
* **Potential scale and control:** A combination could be worth around $3.5 trillion based on current values, and analysts note it might consolidate Musk's influence given his larger voting power at SpaceX.
* **Scrutiny and delay risk:** Some involved in the talks worry Musk's public endorsement could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by weeks, recalling the SolarCity litigation over fairness.

# [AI uncovers PHP bugs that force 70% of websites offline](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Artificial intelligence helped researchers find[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ab912d81-803a-4e56-b7e9-1ce8134ccbc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[two critical remote-code-execution vulnerabilities](https://substack.com/redirect/ab912d81-803a-4e56-b7e9-1ce8134ccbc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in PHP **[that affect roughly 70% of websites,](https://substack.com/redirect/9c00985d-edc2-4a24-97d3-21e161ae6f45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** prompting governments and companies to take sites offline while patches roll out.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Decade-old flaws exposed:** The vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, rated 9.2 severity, affect all PHP installations serving web requests going back to version 5 from 2004.
* **AI accelerated discovery:** Wiz researchers used Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol; OpenAI and Calif independently found issues with GPT-5.6 Sol under an OpenAI-funded audit, turning hidden bugs into working exploits quickly.
* **Immediate action ordered:** The U.S. National Security Agency and European agencies advised organizations to patch immediately or pull vulnerable systems offline; French, Dutch, Finnish and other government sites went dark.
* **Scale of exposure:** PHP powers about 70% of websites including WordPress and Drupal; Cloudflare and others reported millions of exploitation attempts as patches were issued to PHP 8.5.12.

# [Meta's $64.6B quarter fails to calm $145B AI spending fears](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meta posted **[$64.6 billion in third-quarter revenue,](https://substack.com/redirect/625d8328-d33b-47d1-a298-fb2547aac65d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a 26% jump, yet shares fell as free cash flow turned negative, a New Mexico court levied a $25 billion privacy fine, and the company restructured shares to **[keep its founder in California.](https://substack.com/redirect/653f5555-e2f7-4059-a762-3fa275270703?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue beats, cash turns:** Advertising revenue climbed 26% to $63.1 billion on a 14% rise in average ad prices, but free cash flow fell to negative $2.1 billion after $34.9 billion in capital outlays.
* **$25 billion New Mexico hit:** A Santa Fe judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after a jury found more than 43 million violations of the state's unfair-practices law over misleading statements tied to the Cambridge Analytica data practices.
* **Founder alignment on tax:** Meta will issue non-voting Class C shares in January, letting Mark Zuckerberg sell a portion immediately for liquidity while committing to remain a California resident for eight years under a potential 5% wealth tax.
* **Muse shopping traction:** More than 10 million people in the U.S. and Canada set up Muse agents in roughly six weeks, with about a quarter of engaged users shopping at an average purchase size above $200.

# [Oil hits $112 and Wall Street's "AI patience" finally snaps](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
U.S. **[stock futures fell sharply Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/7e85aef3-9e2d-4b16-854a-5eb26716f6a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Meta and Tesla earnings failed to ease **[artificial-intelligence spending worries,](https://substack.com/redirect/f8fe2abd-a792-4ab4-ab0c-cdbf5ca4dcf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while Brent crude topped $112 a barrel on Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia and reports of planned post-midterm strikes on Iran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Futures drop on tech:** Nasdaq futures declined about 1.7% and the S&P 500 fell nearly 1% in premarket trading as investors punished higher Meta capital plans and lower Tesla 2026 spending targets despite both companies beating expectations.
* **Meta and Tesla reverse:** Meta shares erased early after-hours gains and Tesla fell around 5% premarket, with Barron's noting that good results were not enough for the AI trade.
* **Brent above $112:** Crude rose more than 3% after a Houthi drone strike on Saudi Arabia's Shaybah oilfield killed two people and the United States ordered diplomats and families to leave the kingdom.
* **Post-midterm strike plans:** The New York Times reported that the United States and Israel are preparing for possible strikes on Iran after the November midterm elections, adding to inflation fears across oil-importing Asia.

# [Tesla quietly cuts 2026 capex by $5B after mixed quarter](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tesla **[beat adjusted-earnings expectations](https://substack.com/redirect/71a74a86-2c4a-4f0c-9038-485c19f072bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the third quarter but reported flat revenue and a sharp drop in GAAP profit, then **[lowered its 2026 capital-spending outlook to roughly $20 billion.](https://substack.com/redirect/96951ecd-81c4-4a51-8785-1cfba9ef4ce0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue flat, profit down:** Automotive revenue was roughly flat year over year while GAAP net income fell 43% to $787 million; non-GAAP EPS of $0.48 topped the roughly $0.45 consensus.
* **Energy and cash flow:** Energy generation and storage revenue declined 16% to $2.9 billion; free cash flow came in at $1.53 billion after capital expenditures of $4.73 billion, more than double a year earlier.
* **2026 spending guide cut:** Management reduced the 2026 capital-expenditure outlook to about $20 billion from the prior expectation of more than $25 billion.
* **Demand still exceeds output:** Executives said vehicle demand outpaced production, pointing to Full Self-Driving software, energy-storage orders, and early Robotaxi operations as growth drivers.

Anthropic released a research preview of Claude Duet, **[a proactive personal AI agent designed to monitor apps,](https://substack.com/redirect/4e2e25d1-b746-4a32-be33-e23a794b1536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** surface priorities, and execute tasks, positioning it against Grok Bot, Muse and Dots.

* **Research preview launch:** The agent is available to U.S. Pro and Max subscribers through a waitlist, with both mobile and desktop versions.
* **Proactive task handling:** Claude Duet continuously monitors connected applications, surfaces the highest-priority items, and can carry out background actions without constant user prompts.
* **Competitive positioning:** Anthropic framed the product as a direct response to xAI's Grok Bot, Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots in the emerging personal-agent category.
* **Early access limits:** The company has not disclosed a broader public release timeline beyond the current restricted preview.

# [French yields hit 5% as $112 oil and protests collide](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
French 10-year yields **[climbed toward multi-decade highs](https://substack.com/redirect/be327e6d-dd3e-415d-b0a7-0156d1d09e89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while the spread over German Bunds widened sharply, as oil above $112 and political tension added to pressure already visible in European markets.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Yields hit fresh highs:** French 10-year OATs moved toward levels last seen around 2002, with the OAT-Bund spread expanding amid the broader risk-off move.
* **Oil adds inflation pressure:** Brent above $112 on Middle East developments raised concerns about energy costs across Europe, which imports most of its fuel.
* **Political backdrop:** Ongoing fiscal and political friction in France contributed to the yield move even as U.S. Treasury yields declined on safe-haven flows.
* **European risk-off:** The STOXX 600 gave back prior gains as higher oil and wider French spreads weighed on sentiment.

# [Kalshi lets you borrow against bitcoin without selling a coin](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Prediction market Kalshi will let some prime clients **[use Bitcoin and Ether held at BitGo as collateral](https://substack.com/redirect/7417a6c9-3060-436b-b70c-f758eef51834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for leveraged perpetual futures, while the OCC finalized the first GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers effective in January 2027.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cd458bf-4563-4013-968e-ef61679d1d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bitcoin-backed perps collateral:** Kalshi arranged with BitGo so select clients can post crypto-secured loans from a lending affiliate against Bitcoin and ether to margin perpetual-futures trades.
* **OCC sets GENIUS framework:** The Comptroller finalized requirements covering reserves, redemptions, custody and risk management for payment stablecoins, with the law and rule taking effect January 18, 2027.
* **No direct issuer yields:** The rules ban stablecoin issuers from paying yield directly to customers, though the OCC will evaluate third-party reward arrangements case by case.
* **Crypto stocks rally on clarity:** Strategy shares rose 7% and Galaxy Digital 8% after the framework, with Circle up 5% and Coinbase up 4%, while bitcoin ETFs drew more than $1.07 billion over three sessions.

Energy and cash flow: Energy generation and storage revenue declined 16% to $2.9 billion; free cash flow came in at $1.53 billion after capital expenditures of $4.73 billion, more than double a year earlier. 2026 spending guide cut: Management reduced the 2026 capital-expenditure outlook to about $20 billion from the prior expectation of more than $25 billion. Demand still exceeds output: Executives said vehicle demand outpaced production, pointing to Full Self-Driving software, energy-storage orders, and early Robotaxi operations as growth drivers. Anthropic released a research preview of Claude Duet, surface priorities, and execute tasks, positioning it against Grok Bot, Muse and Dots. | | ---|---|--- Research preview launch: The agent is available to U.S. Pro and Max subscribers through a waitlist, with both mobile and desktop versions. Proactive task handling: Claude Duet continuously monitors connected applications, surfaces the highest-priority items, and can carry out background actions without constant user prompts. Competitive positioning: Anthropic framed the product as a direct response to xAI's Grok Bot, Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots in the emerging personal-agent category. Early access limits: The company has not disclosed a broader public release timeline beyond the current restricted preview. French 10-year yields while the spread over German Bunds widened sharply, as oil above $112 and political tension added to pressure already visible in European markets. | | ---|---|--- Yields hit fresh highs: French 10-year OATs moved toward levels last seen around 2002, with the OAT-Bund spread expanding amid the broader risk-off move. Oil adds inflation pressure: Brent above $112 on Middle East developments raised concerns about energy costs across Europe, which imports most of its fuel. Political backdrop: Ongoing fiscal and political friction in France contributed to the yield move even as U.S. Treasury yields declined on safe-haven flows. European risk-off: The STOXX 600 gave back prior gains as higher oil and wider French spreads weighed on sentiment. Prediction market Kalshi will let some prime clients for leveraged perpetual futures, while the OCC finalized the first GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers effective in January 2027. | | ---|---|--- Bitcoin-backed perps collateral: Kalshi arranged with BitGo so select clients can post crypto-secured loans from a lending affiliate against Bitcoin and ether to margin perpetual-futures trades. OCC sets GENIUS framework: The Comptroller finalized requirements covering reserves, redemptions, custody and risk management for payment stablecoins, with the law and rule taking effect January 18, 2027. No direct issuer yields: The rules ban stablecoin issuers from paying yield directly to customers, though the OCC will evaluate third-party reward arrangements case by case. Crypto stocks rally on clarity: Strategy shares rose 7% and Galaxy Digital 8% after the framework, with Circle up 5% and Coinbase up 4%, while bitcoin ETFs drew more than $1.07 billion over three sessions. body:
These are the days that decide everything

| |
---
Friend, Election Day is less than two weeks away. After months of door knocks, phone banks, town events, and ads, this campaign is down to its final days. _**In a district like NJ-09, these are the days that decide everything.**_ Think about how this district has voted recently: Trump carried it in 2024. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
I met Cliff at the Delta Farmers Market, about an hour south of Grand Junction. Cliff made beautiful little wooden boxes, and I picked one up for Kit. After introducing myself as a candidate for State Treasurer, Cliff leaned back and with narrowed eyes asked, “Democrat or Republican?”
In one of the most Republican parts of the state I answered, “Democrat.”
He looked at me for a bit and replied, “I’ve voted Republican my whole life. This year, I’m voting for every Democrat I can find!”

* Infrastructure that brings good-paying jobs to Colorado

Peter, I can’t make this up. Vivek Ramaswamy has unleashed attack ads against me that have gone too far.
He’s stooped so low that even Republicans are calling him out. He’s showing Ohio exactly who he is: ** a man willing to go to despicable lows to win. **
**But the fact of the matter is the polls still show this is anyone’s race.** Experts are calling our election _the most competitive governor’s race in the country, so even a few hundred votes could change things._
**[I’m urgently asking you to split a contribution between my campaign and Wes Moore to help me fight back and win this election, not just for me, but for the people of Ohio. Even $3 can make a difference.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261022-3.gFg7IW&refcode=em-20261022-3&t=2&akid=2171%2E1086043%2EsJsm2q)**

But I’ll be frank – we’re still being outspent by a large margin, and if we allow him to dominate the airwaves for these final 12 days, we’ll be at a real disadvantage on Election Day.

| | Hello Peter,

I’ll get right to it, because every hour matters now.
**Today our digital ads and text campaign came to a screeching halt.** With just 12 days until Election Day, that’s the last place we want to be, and I need your help to get them running again.
First, I want to say **thank you.** Because of you, our billboards are up along **I-75 and I-71** , our signs are standing at **polling places** across the district, and our **postcards** are ready to land in voters’ mailboxes. That happened because neighbors like you believed in this campaign and gave what you could. I don’t take that for granted.
Today we file our pre-general report with the FEC, and the message from this moment is clear: **we can’t take our foot off the gas.** The voters we reach in these final days decide close races, and the most effective, affordable ways to reach them are digital ads and text messages. When those go quiet, thousands of voters stop hearing from us right when they’re making up their minds.
**We need to raise $9,750 to turn them back on.**
**Here’s how you can help today:**
💻 **Restart our digital and text outreach.** A gift of any size gets us back on screens and phones:
👉 [**Donate now: enochforcongress.com/donate-now**](https://us.list-manage.com/JrCNqRo7QS3?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)

Every $25 keeps a voter conversation going. Every book of stamps puts our message in another household’s hands. Please give what you can today, and let’s get our message back on the road.

name: OnePA Team
subject: RE: Our families deserve the paid leave we’reorganizing to win
body:
Working families organized and won in Allegheny County. Let’s carry that momentum into every state capital and defend the progress we’ve made. | |
---
Peter, **Now, state legislators across Pennsylvania and the country must act.** OnePA joined nurses, parents, unions, and community organizations in pushing for this victory. Their organizing challenged corporate opposition and put families’ health and economic security at the center of the debate. Parents need time to recover from childbirth and care for a new child. Without paid leave, that time can mean lost income, overdue bills, and pressure to return to work before a family is ready. Workers in low-wage jobs and families with little savings face especially steep barriers. **Paid parental leave should be guaranteed by law, with meaningful pay and strong protections against retaliation.** Access to time with a new child should extend across communities, workplaces, and income levels. Local organizing is moving paid leave forward. State lawmakers have the power to extend those victories to millions more families and protect the gains communities have already secured. clean_body: Working families organized and won in Allegheny County. Let’s carry that momentum into every state capital and defend the progress we’ve made. | | Peter, Now, state legislators across Pennsylvania and the country must act. OnePA joined nurses, parents, unions, and community organizations in pushing for this victory. Their organizing challenged corporate opposition and put families’ health and economic security at the center of the debate. Parents need time to recover from childbirth and care for a new child. Without paid leave, that time can mean lost income, overdue bills, and pressure to return to work before a family is ready. Workers in low-wage jobs and families with little savings face especially steep barriers. Paid parental leave should be guaranteed by law, with meaningful pay and strong protections against retaliation. Access to time with a new child should extend across communities, workplaces, and income levels. Local organizing is moving paid leave forward. State lawmakers have the power to extend those victories to millions more families and protect the gains communities have already secured. | | Together, we’re demanding policies that put working people first. -OnePA | OnePA is a 501(c)4 organization Contributions to OnePA are not tax deductible for federal income tax purposes Our mailing address is P.O. name: Molly Gray
subject: My visit to Copley Hospital & why we need Universal Primary Care
body:
Hi Peter, Earlier this week, I visited Copley Hospital in Morrisville, where I had an informative tour and conversation about the challenges facing our rural hospitals and the opportunities to build a stronger healthcare system for all Vermonters.

I left with numerous ideas, as well as an even deeper understanding of what a **[universal primary care](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141972391/655359751/-732163825?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjJkZjM2MS00NmNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TCyqmoWjiD0s_kjwt6yJfX5BA4pFkWiP045efIo3n34=&emci=33485f76-44ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=322df361-46ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=43402276)system could mean for rural communities across our state**. Every Vermonter deserves access to quality, affordable primary care, regardless of their age, income, or ZIP code. Across Vermont, a lack of access to basic preventative and mental health care in our communities, is forcing rural hospitals, and [emergency service providers](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141972392/655359752/969885513?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjJkZjM2MS00NmNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TCyqmoWjiD0s_kjwt6yJfX5BA4pFkWiP045efIo3n34=&emci=33485f76-44ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=322df361-46ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=43402276), to serve as primary care physicians. Hospital emergency rooms are the most expensive place to treat common colds, infections, or chronic health tracking. What is more, when emergency service providers begin responding to calls for basic preventative care, the cost shifts to our municipalities and draws resources away from true emergencies. Ultimately, the primary care crisis unfolding across Vermont, is driving up hospital costs, and related health insurance premiums. And we all know how health insurance premiums are bankrupting Vermont families, harming Vermont businesses, driving up education spending and property taxes. **If we want to truly lower costs for Vermonters, and deliver health care as a human right, we have an obligation to ensure every Vermonter can access basic preventative and mental healthcare in their community.** **But universal primary care isn’t the only answer, I also heard proposals for advanced coordination and cooperation across all Vermont hospitals, the need for a statewide, shared electronic medical records system, and strategies to recruit and retain primary care providers.** As Lieutenant Governor, I'll work to bring the practical solutions, voices and expertise of Vermonters directly to the policymaking table. And, you can count on me to fight for an accessible and affordable healthcare system, so that all Vermonters, but especially those in our rural communities, can get the care they deserve. You can learn more about my healthcare priorities [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141972393/655359753/-1662054583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjJkZjM2MS00NmNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TCyqmoWjiD0s_kjwt6yJfX5BA4pFkWiP045efIo3n34=&emci=33485f76-44ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=322df361-46ce-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=43402276). Thank you for standing with me for stronger rural healthcare and a healthier future for every Vermonter. With gratitude, _Molly Gray_ | | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141972394/655359754/679520187?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjJkZjM2MS00NmNlLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TCyqmoWjiD0s_kjwt6yJfX5BA4pFkWiP045efIo3n34=)

No one should be dying of measles in 2026 in America – yet here we are.| | | |
---

---
Hi Peter,

We are in the middle of the worst measles outbreak in the United States in 35 years, and the federal advisory committee responsible for making vaccine recommendations has not met in over 10 months.

Let that sink in.

Last year, RFK Jr. fired every member of that committee – made up of public health experts, scientists, and doctors – and replaced them with people who share his anti-vax views.

In normal times, the committee meets three times a year. During public health emergencies like the COVID-19 pandemic, it met _three times a week to review safety data and issue guidance. _

_Right now, in the middle of a historic measles outbreak, it is doing nothing._

A functioning panel would be meeting regularly to review case data from across the country and issuing updated vaccine recommendations to stop the spread of the disease. Instead, this administration is spreading misinformation and leaving the states to fend for themselves.

We eliminated measles in the US more than 25 years ago – no one should be dying of this disease in 2026.

Vaccines are one of the greatest achievements in modern medicine. They save lives. They keep communities healthy. RFK Jr.’s conspiracy theories and attacks on vaccines are dragging us back to a time when children were dying from diseases we know how to prevent – and no parent should have to accept that.

**We don’t have to accept needless death and suffering. We just need leaders who trust doctors and believe in science over conspiracy theories. **

Let that sink in. Last year, RFK Jr. fired every member of that committee – made up of public health experts, scientists, and doctors – and replaced them with people who share his anti-vax views. In normal times, the committee meets three times a year. During public health emergencies like the COVID-19 pandemic, it met three times a week to review safety data and issue guidance. Right now, in the middle of a historic measles outbreak, it is doing nothing. A functioning panel would be meeting regularly to review case data from across the country and issuing updated vaccine recommendations to stop the spread of the disease. Instead, this administration is spreading misinformation and leaving the states to fend for themselves. We eliminated measles in the US more than 25 years ago – no one should be dying of this disease in 2026. Vaccines are one of the greatest achievements in modern medicine. They save lives. They keep communities healthy. RFK Jr.’s conspiracy theories and attacks on vaccines are dragging us back to a time when children were dying from diseases we know how to prevent – and no parent should have to accept that. Friend,
I'm going to be honest with you, because I don't know any other way to say this.
My heart breaks for France right now. City halls burning to the ground. More than 600 police officers injured in a single day. Rioters tearing the French flag off the monument to their own Republic – and raising a Palestinian flag in its place, while others march under the hammer and sickle.
Communists and radical Islamists, side by side in the streets. **That 's not a coincidence. That's an alliance.** And it has eyes on more than Europe.
This radical movement is working to infiltrate our own country – and it's counting on patriots like you not realizing it until it's too late.
It is the honor of my life to serve as Florida's U.S. Senator. My state is full of people who already know how this story ends. Families who fled Castro with nothing but the clothes on their backs. Venezuelans who watched their country get looted by socialists in a single generation. Nicaraguans who escaped Ortega. They came here because America was the one place it couldn't happen.
Here, that movement has a fellow traveler on the ballot, and her name is **Angie Nixon.**
She runs a bookstore called "Cafe Resistance." On its wall hang portraits of convicted cop killers – including Assata Shakur, who murdered a New Jersey state trooper and fled to Castro's Cuba. When she was confronted about it, she said she stands by "everything in this bookstore."
She closes her speeches with a line from the Communist Manifesto – "We have nothing to lose but our chains" – and she took that chant to a CAIR gala. She was one of just 7 votes against teaching students the history of communism. She signed the pledge to abolish ICE. She voted against tougher penalties for people who assault police officers.
And she just raised $7 million to take Florida's U.S. Senate seat – more than we raised in the same three months. And Bernie Sanders just pointed his $23 million war chest at this race and came to Florida himself to campaign for her and turn out the vote.
This is a special election – the biggest Senate race in the country this year – and some new polls say it's within the margin of error. If she wins, she becomes **the first dues-paying member of the Democratic Socialists of America in the U.S. Senate.**

name: Mark Ruffalo
subject: Abdul
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3686%2E251025%2EI4UjhV ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3686%2E251025%2EI4UjhV ]Abdul for US Senate

[ Mark ]Mark Ruffalo

Peter,

I am an actor. We play people we are not. We go into their lives to learn
about them and try to tell their stories so that other people understand
them. I've played a reporter, a lawyer, an FBI agent, lots of cops,
lovers, dads and yes, a scientist who turns big and green when he gets mad
and smashes things.

Most of those characters were made up. But the reporter^1 and the lawyer^2
were real people. They told the truth when it cost them something, way
before anyone thought to make a movie about them.

Playing them taught me the difference between looking brave and being
brave.

Bravery is easy to act out. You've read a script. You know how it ends. In
real life, nobody hands you that ending. And a lot of the time, being
brave just means saying out loud what everyone else is pretending not to
see.

So there are some things I can't pretend about.

I can't pretend that what Benjamin Netanyahu's government has done in Gaza
is anything but a genocide. Tens of thousands are dead. Many of them were
children. Last year, a United Nations commission studied the evidence and
reached the same conclusion.^3 As did Israel’s own leading human rights
organization,^4 as well as the International Association of Genocide
Scholars.^5

I can't pretend this war has nothing to do with us, either. My tax dollars
and yours paid for those bombs. Politicians tell us we can't afford to
fully fund our schools. Then they find billions for bombs that fall on the
children of Gaza and other places in the world on behalf of Israel.

The truth is, we can't bomb our way to peace.

My friend Abdul El-Sayed has said so out loud, even when it cost him. He's
the kind of brave in real life I've had the privilege of playing on screen
and knowing off it.

Abdul is a doctor. When Flint's water was poisoned, he was running
Detroit's health department, and he made sure every school in the district
was tested for lead. Flint showed all of us what happens when people in
power decide some lives count for less.

A good doctor doesn't ask where you're from before treating you. Abdul
doesn't either. A child in Gaza. A family in Flint. A retiree in Grand
Rapids who can't afford insulin. To him, every one of those lives is worth
fighting for because they are human beings.

Now he's running against Mike Rogers.

One month into the bombing of Gaza, Rogers said Israel had been “quite
restrained.” When a radio host asked why Israel was holding Palestinian
children in prison, Rogers was quick with a correction: “Minors, not
children.”

Think about that. He is using word tricks to hide injustices. To hide
children in prisons. That is the opposite of bravery. That is cowardice.
To pretend what is wrong is not happening. It says so much about him. We
need stronger, braver leaders for this moment.

The difference between the two candidates could not be clearer. AIPAC saw
it too. That's why they spent tens of millions of dollars trying to sink
Abdul in the primary.

Abdul doesn't take money from AIPAC or corporate PACs. He counts on people
like you to answer the money coming at him.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261022-3-ak.XqQHxF&amount=10&refcode=em20261022-3681&t=1004&akid=3686%2E251025%2EI4UjhV ]So I'm asking you personally: will you chip in to Abdul's campaign
today? With so little time left, every dollar matters in a race this
close.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261022-3-ak.XqQHxF&amount=10&refcode=em20261022-3681&t=1005&akid=3686%2E251025%2EI4UjhV ]Donate ››

I was born on the other side of Lake Michigan. And I can't think of a
better person to serve my Midwestern neighbors in the United States
Senate. But Abdul needs our help.

Nobody is coming to do this for us. We do it together, or it doesn't get
done. We are the ones that we have been waiting for.

In solidarity,

Mark Ruffalo

subject: A personal note from me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
He doesn’t dwell on it, but I want you to understand what this means to people.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=9699%2E582294%2Eq_vilj)
Hi friend,
It’s Vann, Chris’s husband. I don’t often write to you, but I read something this morning I wanted to share.
The New York Times published a profile of Chris today with the headline: _“His Election Could Decide Senate Control. He Could Make History, Too.”_
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261022_4.C5p4QG&refcode=em20261022-4&t=2&akid=9699%2E582294%2Eq_vilj)
**Both halves of that headline are true. But Chris is only focused on the first one.**
That’s who he is. When the _Times_ asked him about making history, he said he isn’t thinking much about it, that he’s focused every day on the people of New Hampshire. On the trail it’s the same: affordable health care, high prices, corruption in Washington. He means every word. It’s one of the many reasons I love him.
But I’m his husband, not his campaign manager, so I get to say the other part out loud: **If Chris wins in less than two weeks, he will be the first out gay man ever to serve in the United States Senate.**
Here’s how long this has taken: Barney Frank became the first member of Congress to come out voluntarily in 1987. It took another 25 years for an openly gay candidate, Tammy Baldwin, to win a Senate seat. And in the entire history of that chamber, **_not one out gay man has ever served there._**
Chris could change that. That matters. It matters to Chris and me, and it matters to people all across this country who have never once seen themselves in that room.
**[In 12 days we can make that history real. If this moment means something to you too, will you chip in to help Chris win?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261022_4.C5p4QG&refcode=em20261022-4&t=3&akid=9699%2E582294%2Eq_vilj)**
When Chris was growing up in Manchester, he attended one of the biggest public high schools in the state, and as far as he knew, there wasn’t a single out student there. No gay-straight alliance. Nobody to look at and think, _that could be me._ He has said he’s now living a life he didn’t think was possible back then.
He came out in college, returned home, and ran for the State House at age 22 without hiding who he was. New Hampshire embraced him then, and it’s embracing him now. Chris likes to point to our state motto, “Live Free or Die.” To him it means people here, whatever their politics, want their neighbors to be free to be themselves. I’ve watched that play out in coffee shops, at town halls, and on front porches across this state.
And Chris has never been quiet about the fight itself. In 2004 his very first speech on the House floor was against a bill to block New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages. He called it what it was. He lost that vote. Five years later New Hampshire legalized marriage equality, six years before it became the law of the land nationwide. In Congress he became co-chair of the Equality Caucus and has championed bills to expand civil rights protections for LGBTQ Americans and to restore benefits for veterans who were discharged just for being who they are.
**I’ve never met anyone more patient about the long game or more stubborn about winning it.**
That’s why it meant so much to me that the _Times_ wrote about a young organizer who said that in part because of Chris, he came out to his family and friends and found out the people around him love him for exactly who he is.
There are kids in high schools all over this country right now walking the same hallway Chris did, unsure whether there will be a place for them wherever they want to end up. They’re watching this race whether anyone tells them to or not. **If Chris wins they’ll see there’s no ceiling on what you can achieve based on who you love.**
Somersworth’s Mayor Gerding told the _Times_ this is the kind of milestone you’d want to sing from the rooftops. I agree. **So consider this email my rooftop.**
And it couldn’t come at a more important moment. Just last week the Vice President mocked a Democratic Senate candidate by falsely suggesting he was gay, as if that were an insult. As Chris put it, cynical attacks on the LGBTQ community have gone mainstream, and a lot of people are scared about where this country is headed. **A win in New Hampshire would be a loud answer.**
Republicans know what’s at stake, too: **This race could decide who controls the Senate.** If we win New Hampshire, Democrats can flip the Senate and finally put a check on this administration. If we lose Republicans keep their grip on the majority, and this era of chaos rolls on. And they’re spending over $60 million to do it.
**[This race is about more than Chris. It’s about the future of our country. So I’m asking you to make a contribution in the final stretch:](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261022_4.C5p4QG&refcode=em20261022-4&t=4&akid=9699%2E582294%2Eq_vilj)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261022_4.C5p4QG&amount=5&refcode=em20261022-4&t=23&akid=9699%2E582294%2Eq_vilj)**
**On November 3rd we have a chance to take back the Senate majority _and_ make history on the same night.**
I’m so proud of Chris. I’m so proud of New Hampshire. Thank you for standing with us.
Vann Bentley
(Chris’s husband)
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20261022-4&t=24&refcode2=9699_582294_q_vilj&akid=9699%2E582294%2Eq_vilj)**

I drove across the entire state of Wisconsin.
Eau Claire. Green Bay. Milwaukee. I went everywhere they asked me to go and I talked to as many people as I could find. And here's what I kept hearing.
Standing Our Ground is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.._x1xPb8RWi2vg9eH6G6g61v_oP0ZBDlFq_5XBqCUTkA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=221684508)
People are tired.
Not fired up angry, not energized, not ready to march. Just tired. Tired of leaders who don't act like leaders. Tired of watching the bar for basic decency keep getting lowered. Tired of being told to pick between two sides when one of the sides has completely lost the plot.
That's what Tom Tiffany has done to Wisconsin.
Tom Tiffany is running for governor. He's an election denier. He's one of the people who voted against certifying the 2020 election and has spent years casting doubt on a system that works. He is now asking the people of Wisconsin to make him their governor. the person responsible for overseeing elections in their state. Think about that for a second.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/36dabb61-b7e5-4c68-a2a1-ab779759a8c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
David Crowley is running against him. Milwaukee County Executive. A man who actually believes in democracy and has said so clearly. He has said he will protect people's ability to cast their ballots. He believes in free and fair elections. He will say it at the mountaintops, as he put it.
That should not be a controversial position for a candidate for governor. It used to not be.
And then there's Derek Van Orden in Wisconsin's 3rd District. Another one. Another person who showed up at the Capitol on January 6th, who has been on the wrong side of history, and who goes back to his district and acts like nothing happened.
I want to tell you something about character. I think about John McCain. A woman at one of his town halls called Barack Obama a terrorist, a Muslim, tried to stoke fear about who he was. McCain shut it down immediately. Barack Obama is a good, decent man. A family man. I don't agree with him on the issues, but that is who he is.
Donald Trump would have turned that woman into a rally chant. And he cleared the way for people like Tom Tiffany and Derek Van Orden to run for office without character being any part of the conversation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/36dcabd2-7352-4322-9139-2c390106a7e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I went to Wisconsin because the people there deserve better than that. Not better policy. Better people. Leaders who tell the truth about elections. Leaders who don't point mobs at government buildings and then pretend it never happened.
The people I met in Eau Claire and Green Bay and Milwaukee. they're good people. They live in communities that are diverse and complicated and real. Their kids go to school with kids whose parents vote completely differently. They want to live affordable lives. They want to be treated with dignity.
They deserve representatives who believe the same thing.
Wisconsin matters. Tiffany needs to lose. Van Orden needs to lose. I went to make the case in person and I'll keep making it.
-Harry

body:
You've had my back

Dear Peter,

It's been a whole year since I sent you the message below.

Since that time, we've made some amazing accomplishments. You helped
me expose Josh Kaul's failing record on crime labs. We received
endorsements from over 80% of Wisconsin sheriffs, another huge
accomplishment. We even had the best initial fundraising quarter for
an attorney general race in Wisconsin history...

And I had a birthday. 😅

But now we're just weeks away from the election, and things are
getting tight. If you're able, please CONSIDER MAKING A CONTRIBUTION
OF $25, $50, OR WHATEVER YOU CAN TO HELP POWER US TO NOVEMBER 3RD.
[https://link.action.erictoney.

Thank you for standing with me this past year. I hope I can count on
you to stay by my side until Election Day.

Eric

_ONE YEAR AGO..._

[https://link.action.erictoney.

Dear friend,

Everything was put into perspective for me two years ago.

I was 39 and had just been told I needed open-heart surgery. Mind you,
I run marathons, so this was never a position I imagined myself being
in.

I promised myself that if I survived that operating table I would do
something with my life to make a difference for Wisconsin, WHICH IS
WHY I AM PROUD TO TELL YOU FIRST THAT I HAVE ENTERED THE RACE TO BE
YOUR NEXT ATTORNEY GENERAL.

You and your families deserve SAFE communities, victims DESERVE
JUSTICE, and criminals deserve to face the REPERCUSSIONS of their
actions. _But under the current AG, Josh Kaul, we aren’t seeing
justice. _

A border that has been too open for too long has allowed our
communities to be flooded with meth and fentanyl, overwhelming our
local resources and resulting in the needless deaths of Wisconsinites.
A_pparently, to Josh Kaul, this is just the new normal..._

IT'S TIME FOR A CHANGE. AND I'M READY TO BRING THAT CHANGE.

Please consider helping me in these critical early weeks by
contributing $1,000, or any generous amount up to $20,000 per person.
[https://link.action.erictoney.

This isn’t a vanity campaign; I have the tried-and-true credentials
it takes to be successful. As a District Attorney and having been
President of the Wisconsin District Attorneys Association, I always
put public safety over politics.

I’m proud to have worked across party lines with a Democrat Governor
and a Republican Legislature to deliver pay raises for our prosecutors
and public defenders, as well as create over 50 new prosecutor
positions where they were needed the most.

_With your support, we can turn our state around, starting on Day One,
to make our communities safer, restore competence to the crime labs,
confront the drug crisis with the urgency it demands, and protect
Wisconsin._

Are you with me?

[https://link.action.erictoney.

ERIC TONEY
_Republican Candidate for Wisconsin Attorney General _

[https://link.action.erictoney.

Fellow American, it's Michele Tafoya.

I've been on the road a lot recently, pressed for time, hopping from one city to the next, but I still wanted to take some time out of my day to write to you.I didn't waste time sending this to my team for final review; I wanted to get this over to you as soon as I possibly could.

If you've been following what's happening in Minnesota, here's where we're at now:
1. The latest polls now have me and my Far Left opponent, Peggy Flanagan, DEAD EVEN in the home stretch. Voters are clearly demanding change.
2. My campaign has been surging past our expectations thanks to thousands of grassroots patriots like you chipping in just $5 or $10 whenever they can (contrary to my socialist opponent's wealthy boosters).
3. The Democrat political machine has invested thousands in bogus attack ads in Minnesota against me because they're terrified of us pulling off the upset.

It's clear now, more than ever, that the tides are turning in our direction. I wanted to show you, in these points above, some of the fruits of all of our hard work together.
__But the final buzzer still hasn 't sounded, and you don't get a prize for winning the 3rd quarter when there's plenty of time left in the game!__
I've seen first-hand PLENTY of teams who think they've got the win in the bag take their foot off the gas and go on defense... all to face defeat right before the clock hits zero.
**We won 't be that team.**
If anything, we're itching to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. We've known since the start of this movement that we're the clear underdog in this race.
But we're FAR from throwing in the towel.
Now that we're in the home stretch, your direct support to me and this movement becomes even more important.
Truth be told, it'd be a disaster if we lost you, Fellow American.

I'm going to be blunt - if Andy Barr wanted to lower your cost of living, he'd be doing it already.
He's had 14 years in Congress to do so. Ask yourself: have your bills gone down since?
I know when I check my mail, I'm filled with dread because I know what's coming - another month of stretching every dollar to pay for my family's basic necessities.
That's why I've centered this campaign on affordability; it's not just a talking point. It's based on my lived experience.
We're in a vicious cycle where Andy uses false promises, blame games, and blind partisan loyalty to evade any accountability for our failing economy. Meanwhile, he's become a _millionaire_ while in Congress.
It's wrong, and frankly offensive, that Andy would expect us to settle for Senator Andy "low" Barr so he can keep getting richer.
And working people are seeing right through it. Across our Commonwealth, former Trump supporters are standing side by side with our movement, seeking real change.
_That 's why in "deep-red" Kentucky, we're currently tied in the polls._
I know Kentuckians deserve better. But this grassroots campaign is 100% people-powered, so I'm counting on your help to turn this tie into a win.
Will you contribute $25 to my campaign so I can power my turnout programs and reach every undecided voter?

Together,
_Charles Booker_

Peter, I have served in the Texas Legislature for four terms, and have watched Dan Patrick run the Senate like it belonged to him. He decides which bills get a hearing and which ones die in committee. He appoints the committee chairs. He controls who gets recognized on the floor. He co-chairs the Legislative Budget Board that shapes how Texas spends your money. **Every lever of power in that chamber runs through Dan’s office as the Lieutenant Governor.**

This week, _Quorum Report_ confirmed what sources in Austin have been saying for weeks: members of the Texas Senate GOP Caucus have been consulting with attorneys about how to strip legislative powers from the Lieutenant Governor's office** _ if I win._** **They want to change the rules because ****they are afraid of who is about to enforce them.**** ** **Many of the Lt. Governor's powers don't come from the Texas Constitution. They come from the Senate, which means a simple Republican majority can rewrite them the day I take office.**** ** The same rules Dan Patrick has used for over a decade — to block Medicaid expansion, pass the school voucher scam, and drive the most extreme agenda Texas has ever seen. Those rules could be quietly handed to a Republican Majority Leader elected by the GOP caucus alone.

This is not the first time they've tried this trick. Back in the '90s, a newly-empowered GOP majority tried the same thing against Democratic Lt. Gov. Bob Bullock. It took Governor George W. Bush _personally_ convincing them to stand down. This time, there is no George W. Bush to talk them down. Just an election that is genuinely too close to call according to their own private polling... And a Republican caucus that is already planning for a Texas where Vikki Goodwin is Lieutenant Governor.
**I say,****_let's prove them right._**

| | | Peter, I have good news and bad news. Which do you want first? Since you can’t answer, I’m going to start with the good: **We can win this race.** I believe that in my bones. I wish you all could feel the energy coming from every corner of the district, with folks who have never been political before showing up, ready to demand something better. Farmers, veterans, nurses, parents, students, Democrats, Republicans, Independents – Virginians of all kinds, of all beliefs, of all political persuasions are sick of what’s coming out of Washington and ready to elect someone who will go to bat for their lives, their families, and their futures. For those of you who care more about data than the feeling in my bones, I also have good news – our polling shows me in a dead heat with John McGuire, and when voters learn about his record, I pull into the lead. National polling shows a generic ballot at D+11 – just one less point than McGuire won this seat by in 2024. And we are straight-up shattering records for early votes never seen in any midterm election before. _But as I said, there’s also bad news._ **Our donations are slowing down. A lot. body:
| | | | Hi Friend,
If you live in Virginia’s 10th District, odds are you know what it is like to have a data center on every corner, transmission line projects looming over your neighborhood, and a higher energy bill every month.
_If you are looking for someone to hold accountable, look at Suhas Subramanyam._
---
[](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
Suhas Subramanyam says he warned our then-congresswoman about data centers 10 years ago. He told an interviewer he saw this crisis coming before almost anyone.

Then he climbed from Delegate to State Senator to Congressman in 6 years, representing the most data-center-dense stretch of land in the country the whole time.
In those 6 years, **he did not offer a single bill or action to stop data centers from being built in our neighborhoods.** Not one thing he did stopped a data center from going up in our communities.
He did find time to act when it was convenient. Eight weeks before Election Day, he announced a package of bills that ask agencies for best practices and measurements. None of it limits where a data center can be built, and none of it will pass this Congress.
**That is an announcement timed for an election, not a plan for the families who live next to these buildings.**
Suhas votes with his party 96% of the time. **When his party wants action, he acts. When it does not, our families wait.**
**I have a real plan.** I will fight for real limits on where data centers can be built. I will make the companies driving the demand pay for the grid, not your family. And I will fight to start putting new data centers somewhere other than our backyard.
You can [read my full plan here](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
**Data centers should answer to us, not the other way around.**
But I cannot do this without you. Suhas and his allies are counting on you to stay quiet and let another 2 years go by.
With early voting ending October 31st and Election Day on November 3rd, every dollar helps us reach the voters who will decide this race.
**Will you chip in $10 or $20 today to hold Suhas accountable?**
[CHIP IN TO UNSEAT SUHAS](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
|
---
| | | God Bless, Dave Beckwith
**Beckwith for Congress** _Restoring Faith in the American Dream_ __
__
__
___P.S. Suhas has had 6 years to protect our neighborhoods from data centers, and families are still waiting. Chip in $10 or $20 today and help me bring a new voice to Congress, one that will actually speak up for our communities, before Election Day on November 3rd
_

And that’s not because of what my campaign is spending. It’s because of what they're spending against us. This $7 million gap is outrageous, but it’s not insurmountable — because I’m not trying to match the GOP super PACs dollar for dollar. I’m just trying to raise enough to get my message out. = = I’ve won this seat twice while being outspent, and both times it came down to enough people deciding Southwest Washington wasn’t for sale. We can do it again this year — I really believe that. But not if we don’t act now. Ballots are already in people’s hands, so every day MAGA runs unanswered ads is a day voters fill them out without the full story in front of them. = = | | | Thanks for sticking with me, Marie Gluesenkamp Perez | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Congresswoman Marie Gluesenkamp Perez represents Washington’s 3rd Congressional District. Peter , **Less than two weeks to go until the midterm elections![Before we ask if you can help get out the vote for Democracy Defenders in tight races with a donation of $5 or any amount,](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141979453/655383499/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_TwoWeeksLeft_email_20261022-NDRC-Tier1-TwoWeeksLeft_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20261022-NDRC-Tier1-TwoWeeksLeft_&utm_campaign=TwoWeeksLeft&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ4NWU2M2JlLTU2Y2UtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMjI0ODI5Zjg2OSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z8ISUcZSUeAu9musjeg8mnfvo9GHJtN1B4kw_Qt5usg=)** we want to give you an insider’s briefing on where things stand for our movement: _The fairness of this year’s maps: _ Republicans knew it’d be incredibly tough to defend their record, so they tried to cheat. They tried to manipulate the maps enough to guarantee themselves control of the House. And they did eke out an unearned advantage. But we fought back as a strong, unified grassroots movement, and the GOP failed to cement their grip on the House. Now they’ll need to face the music on November 3rd. _How to stop Republicans’ NEXT power grab attempt: _ Critical state-level races will help decide who controls upcoming rounds of redistricting and who can set future rules around voting access. **If the GOP holds onto enough control at the state level, they can muscle through new gerrymanders and voter suppression measures. They seem set on attacking the fairness of future elections as soon as the dust settles after Election Day.** So we’ve endorsed over 300 Democracy Defenders in critical state-level races for protecting free and fair elections. _But candidates we’ve endorsed are in hotly contested toss-ups: _ The independent election analysts at _Real Clear Politics_ recently rated **FIVE of our targeted governor’s races as toss-ups:** Texas, Wisconsin, Florida, Georgia, and Ohio. clean_body: Democracy Defenders are in tight races right now, and they need our support | Peter , Less than two weeks to go until the midterm elections we want to give you an insider’s briefing on where things stand for our movement: The fairness of this year’s maps: Republicans knew it’d be incredibly tough to defend their record, so they tried to cheat. They tried to manipulate the maps enough to guarantee themselves control of the House. And they did eke out an unearned advantage. But we fought back as a strong, unified grassroots movement, and the GOP failed to cement their grip on the House. Now they’ll need to face the music on November 3rd. How to stop Republicans’ NEXT power grab attempt: Critical state-level races will help decide who controls upcoming rounds of redistricting and who can set future rules around voting access. If the GOP holds onto enough control at the state level, they can muscle through new gerrymanders and voter suppression measures. They seem set on attacking the fairness of future elections as soon as the dust settles after Election Day. So we’ve endorsed over 300 Democracy Defenders in critical state-level races for protecting free and fair elections. But candidates we’ve endorsed are in hotly contested toss-ups: The independent election analysts at Real Clear Politics recently rated FIVE of our targeted governor’s races as toss-ups: Texas, Wisconsin, Florida, Georgia, and Ohio. And the forecasters at Sabato’s Crystal Ball say we’re in SIX toss-ups for controlling key state legislative chambers: the Arizona House and Senate, the Minnesota House and Senate, the Pennsylvania Senate, and the Wisconsin House. name: Dr. Amy Acton
subject: Sorry to reach out again, but this is urgent
body:
Vivek Ramaswamy and his allies are launching baseless attacks against me and outspending us. Polls show this race is statistically tied so we need your help to respond.
#
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=202501-314-acton-split.FLtK7Y&refcode=em20261022-1725&t=1&akid=1725%2E2118727%2Eptjzzi)
I’m Dr. Amy Acton, Democratic nominee for Governor here in Ohio. I’m sorry to interrupt your day, but I'm just not sure where else to turn.
**My opponent, Vivek Ramaswamy, has unleashed attack ads against me that have gone too far.** He’s stooped so low that even Republicans are calling him out. He’s showing Ohio exactly who he is: **a man willing to go to despicable lows to win.**
The polls still show this is anyone’s race and we’re being outspent in every corner of the state by a 7:1 margin. I really wish I didn’t have to keep asking, and I’m sure you’ve got a lot of folks asking for help.
[**But will you please chip in a few dollars to me and 314 Action to save our chances of winning Ohio? Even $10 can make a difference in a race that could come down to just hundreds of votes.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22104?c0=202501-314-acton-split.xKIvrg&refcode=em20261022-1725&t=2&akid=1725%2E2118727%2Eptjzzi)
Ohio Governor Race Poll: Siena College
Dr. Amy Acton (D): 47%
Vivek Ramaswamy (R): 47% **[DONATE TODAY ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=202501-314-acton-split.FLtK7Y&refcode=em20261022-1725&t=3&akid=1725%2E2118727%2Eptjzzi)**
---
You always remember who had your back early on in a campaign. And **314 Action was there from the start** on Day One and I’m so grateful for that. They’re working to ensure that leaders making decisions about our healthcare actually follow the facts, data, and science.
Ohio deserves a leader with integrity and compassion. I refuse to sit by and let a self-serving billionaire ruthlessly hurl personal attacks at me and others to get what he wants. But here’s the hard truth: **Vivek Ramaswamy has the upper hand financially right now.**
He’s a billionaire backed by other billionaires, and he and his super PAC allies have already poured $145 MILLION into ads attacking me. Meanwhile, I rely on folks like you chipping in $5 or $10 at a time to power my campaign.
If we don't take action ASAP and answer these attacks, it could cost us this race. That's why we’re racing to raise $150,000 ahead of our midnight deadline to keep our own ads on the air. But I need your help.
**[I only have until midnight to close this fundraising gap, and the only way it’ll happen is with your support. So please, rush a donation to me and 314 Action today>>](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=202501-314-acton-split.FLtK7Y&refcode=em20261022-1725&t=4&akid=1725%2E2118727%2Eptjzzi)**

Thanks for your help,
Amy 💙

Thanks for your help, Amy 💙 LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.

In 2016,
Andrew Oldham said this at a Federalist Society event:

“It’s not that I disagree with a particular Department of Labor regulation
or a particular IRS regulation. It is the entire existence of this edifice
of administrative law [that] is constitutionally suspect.”

Translation — the rules that keep your workplace safe, your water clean,
and your retirement savings protected? Oldham thinks they shouldn’t exist
at all.

Two years later, Trump gave him a lifetime seat on a federal appeals
court. He was 39, which means he’ll be deciding cases that shape your life
for decades.

He’s already attacked the watchdog agencies that protect workers, helping
pave the way for a Supreme Court ruling that lets a president fire their
leaders at will. And he struck down a rule requiring big companies to be
more open with investors, handing corporations a roadmap to attack others
like it.

Again and again, giant corporations and the ultra-wealthy win. And working
families lose.

Oldham isn’t a fluke. For decades, corporations and right-wing operatives
poured money into building a pipeline of judges who would rule for big
business. Call it what it is: the Oligarchy’s bench. And Oldham is exactly
what they paid for.

Demand Justice PAC is exposing Trump’s crony judges, calling out the
people who put them there, and building the fight to fix our courts. But
we can’t do it without grassroots support.

Friends,
Yesterday, I went live for my last debate against Roger Marshall before the election.
Before stepping onto the stage, I found myself thinking,_this is our last, best chance to hold Sen. Marshall accountable for turning his back on the people of Kansas._ Even more than that,_it 's my chance, my responsibility and my honor to speak up for people in every corner of the state who feel ignored and betrayed by him._
I've heard from thousands of Kansans who have watched Roger Marshall put his party and his politics ahead of them:
❌ They've talked to me about the harm the tariffs have caused them and their families
❌ The devastation they've experienced because of the healthcare cuts
❌ The impact skyrocketing gas prices have on their lives
❌ And the anger they felt when Sen. Marshall rubber-stamped every one of these policies instead of standing up and saying "No, this is bad for Kansas."
**Last night, I was speaking for each and every one of those people when I shared my vision for a better future. When I talked about some of the ways I 'll fix the problems that Sen. Marshall helped create. When I made it clear that once I'm elected to the U.S. Senate, I will be a true champion for Kansans in every corner of the state.**
Heading into the debate, I was excited about the momentum of our incredible grassroots movement -- the polls that show me with a narrow lead over Sen. Marshall, the endorsements from former governors of Kansas and the many election experts who have shifted this race to a toss-up.
Post-debate, that excitement has only grown. You see, I'm ready to serve the people of Kansas. I'm ready to stand up for them, to fight for them and to work every single day to make their lives better. And I know, after listening to them, that they're ready for that kind of leader.
_They know we can do better. We MUST do better. And we will._
We CAN win this, but we aren't home free just yet. Just a few days ago, President Trump came to Kansas to rally for Roger Marshall. Super PACs are spending millions lying about me and my record. And their tactics might be working: With early voting underway across the state, polls show this race is closer than ever.
**Friends, I know what an incredible grassroots team we 've built. I know more than 100,000 of you share my vision for a better future for Kansas and our country. Now, we just need to make sure every undecided Kansas voter understands this vision, too. We have to make it clear to them that a vote for Roger Marshall is a vote for six more years of a leader who will ignore them, turn his back on them and betray them.**
**[That's why I'm personally asking: In these crucial final weeks, will you chip in whatever you can to help us reach our $500,000 post-debate goal, keep our ads on the air and flip this must-win seat?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/97764e22-899e-447b-9656-6a9cdc083830?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/97764e22-899e-447b-9656-6a9cdc083830?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With you by my side, I know we can do this.
Thank you,
Adam Hamilton

J.D. Vance really wants Donald Trump's endorsement for 2028. There's just one problem: Trump won't give it to him.
Vance is already publicly speculating about inheriting the MAGA movement while Marco Rubio, Pete Hegseth, and others circle the same prize. And Trump? He seems perfectly happy watching them fight for his approval.

* [**00:06:17**] We look at the polling around Trump's potential successors, and why none of the biggest names in his administration appear particularly strong heading toward 2028.

| | | | | On December 14, President Trump will gather the leaders of the world’s largest economies at his private Miami resort.

And I believe what happens there could [change the U.S. dollar forever](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=036149f7a2844fefa60c3d382c7c23db&_e=TRi9LVRk4iytXkVQsba39pmY7PdZuB1kAp3EoUWjShKXwY-zMXxrVvISALEax6IilTKA54PogB_2xinRuX754cB662EySuyVgN42QTXypoBaIfdZpmgWp44yKD-taJCYBDY7swFvAiin7o9KRRE3WoYgJIjd1tRBZJ3OY6adfh0ST5z2ZN_8-6mxkHVPb45NqJvhVmnxxuSIUo8bV7OjjtVBYE8hAUMXz51U_vVPfk95UILTaxUfQQCQBmupWStmG2ELyIQ49qU-dWXGf09aHCZrs1RSUrenZHTan1SnLyWUGF_SeKX6pJVdKAYMmiWPBGnD29JcVnwtRQX9Ov9up5m5rLf3FM1O5JDUbT8JQTpc395fg9usjBRmLbsNPs_RDuI68b_RbYxYTZVdxJUtkxIJf_ajnKbh-eYuEyh2wcI6XsbxgroLCDlEw2ugAoY3rmE-47puwjE8AP5zFayUAmjrhniq2TCyxDuwRcYFCuAohxPI-NSBHXf4BoHwluzFdCUAqyRnBXxN-qDYyIwgQm3xGE_6VFFyUUgEhJGFwX8%3D) – potentially triggering a historic repricing across American markets.

The pieces are already falling into place:

A flurry of executive orders... billion-dollar government stakes in obscure mining companies... a landmark pact with 13 nations... and a special agreement signed by six billionaire tech moguls.

At Trump’s December summit, those pieces could finally be assembled in public for the first time – and [a new kind of dollar](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=036149f7a2844fefa60c3d382c7c23db&_e=TRi9LVRk4iytXkVQsba39pmY7PdZuB1kAp3EoUWjShKXwY-zMXxrVvISALEax6IilTKA54PogB_2xinRuX754cB662EySuyVgN42QTXypoBaIfdZpmgWp44yKD-taJCYBDY7swFvAiin7o9KRRE3WoYgJIjd1tRBZJ3OY6adfh0M9d5ZPlIveqFUR2oIdIk9JpIR8JLxjPDdRpMeXTquXqLGRiD3TnQ8mEfDokmLmBPa0DkBaijFJoCRBpNXOh5mkP1OccQlPKP1eSpweFR9d7C1M6N9HME-ugDqSe7GFBm6lX22Q54gSqBZ5iVuFKhus7EC_tfCIsBAyXRv6QVin22KNoSk1U7_eEQwmF4HfbmZccb4u7gA5jsG4J4bUqYRWJ8Wu5t_SOO-c4hkSlx_rzczUf7cxS_xnlHcVki2ybaGJ3wfbiPlgTenepBb2DPvzzAM4LUxhzHApbZJMbQ94x-REzCSIRcUol8T38C2ojZqU689btYMePCUsQvdV-AmCgwha5bjbBx2ZQGsBZ-fgUWzIH7JZIOIyOahNak_Y4s%3D) presented to the world as a done deal.

Whether you’re a Republican or Democrat – whether you support this monetary shift or oppose it – you could soon be using Trump’s New Dollar.

That’s why I’ve produced [this critical new documentary](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=036149f7a2844fefa60c3d382c7c23db&_e=TRi9LVRk4iytXkVQsba39pmY7PdZuB1kAp3EoUWjShKXwY-zMXxrVvISALEax6IilTKA54PogB_2xinRuX754cB662EySuyVgN42QTXypoBaIfdZpmgWp44yKD-taJCYBDY7swFvAiin7o9KRRE3WoYgJIjd1tRBZJ3OY6adfh3ioQarvvauNHUBlz2x7fOyJ2pNx4vMOa6YyjQqeOZh8msm8p2qmeBdNe0KAY1m52rlwkR-DwPraq_sm5ZfBfJonlAKJVlY2S1COadgs38vK1sI7L6ogEuuh3mm6xnhF6eZVsVdv3RYTBnPI0oVWq9oWHYpByhCHSkCREv7LUwj1Q9vA-rt00HjWO_KhouftZ6pmzE8dItlRGYvLLLUvqN0uf_zse7XPLIoEyz_XdcEr3YXSGKp6Rj4OK9lfKj0xdPS5FKdaUIrkHmX8aI6V3vlg1tVDkLLAs0rgQuT0-O5_xsZuLWfkh9scoMbbHBc1dOtiingSxU_4Id57woynCGyukB28kT1Tjzmdx3OlUaIN-aoMTuhH72cXmpN4aC6lQc%3D) revealing:

Why I believe Trump is desperately trying to reset America’s money...

Why this has nothing to do with Bitcoin or gold – but _is_ tied to the most valuable resource of the 21st century...

And three moves I believe you can make today to prepare – including the name and ticker of the investment I believe could benefit as this shift unfolds.

The last time America reset its money, it reportedly created – on average – more than 1,000 new millionaires every day for five decades.

But that was only one side of the story.

Millions of workers and savers were quietly left behind as their wages stalled, their savings were hollowed out and the American Dream slipped beyond their reach.

Now, I believe that same dividing line could be drawn again.

body:
We can’t win the majority without young people.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261022-1&t=1&akid=4178%2E587540%2Eufu2Je)
I was just on CNN, Peter, and here’s what I said:
**We can’t win the majority without young people.**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261022_1_youngvoters.9nisJ4&refcode=em20261022-4178&t=2&akid=4178%2E587540%2Eufu2Je)
For far too long, the strategy for engaging young people has been wagging fingers and lecturing them about their civic duty, instead of giving them a real reason not only to vote, but to have faith in the leaders entrusted with their future.
**Right now, voters of every age keep telling us the same two things: the cost of living is crushing them, and they’re sick of the corruption.** People are paying more for groceries, gas, rent, and healthcare while billionaires and corporations buy off the politicians who are supposed to represent them.
Young voters have spent their whole lives watching politicians promise change and deliver excuses — and they’ve been waiting for the candidates actually worth fighting for.
That’s exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists. We put bold, progressive fighters in front of young voters who will speak to their values, reject corporate PAC money, and put the interests of working people ahead of the ultra-wealthy and the billionaire donor class.
**I see it every single time I’m on the road with our candidates — when you invest in young voters and offer them leaders who inspire them to have hope,_they show up._**
With just 12 days left until Election Day, our work has never been more critical. Young voters are the key to winning Democratic majorities, and our endorsed candidates are the ones giving them reasons to turn out.
**[Peter, will you make a $5 contribution now to help us elect the next generation of bold, inspiring, people-powered leaders young voters have been waiting for?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261022_1_youngvoters.9nisJ4&refcode=em20261022-4178&amount=5&t=3&akid=4178%2E587540%2Eufu2Je)**

Thank you,
David Hogg
