name: Friends of Maria Jukic
subject: 12 DAYS TO GO! 💙
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Maria Jukic
body:
Billboards, yard signs, commercials, and volunteers in action!

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/AtE3rEd2967?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

**12 days to go!**

There's a lot happening across Northeast Ohio as we head into the final 12 days of this campaign!
Billboards are up. Yard signs are appearing in neighborhoods. Postcards are arriving in mailboxes. Our commercials and digital ads are running, and volunteers are making phone calls across the district.
None of this would be possible without the generosity of our donors, the time and energy of our volunteers, and the support of people throughout our communities. Thank you for everything you've helped make possible.
###
---
|
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/OO4Rp9PJjWx?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| |

### FIVE REASONS WHY MARIA IS RUNNING
###
There's a lot at stake in this election. Maria isn't running for Congress to play politics. She's running because the people of Northeast Ohio deserve a government that works for them.
Here are five things she's fighting for:
**1\. Making Life More Affordable** Groceries, housing, utilities, and healthcare shouldn't keep families up at night. Maria wants to tackle unfair corporate pricing, protect working families from rising costs, and make sure the wealthiest Americans pay their fair share.
**2\. Healthcare You Can Count On** After 24 years at Cleveland Clinic, Maria knows what happens when people can't afford the care they need. She's fighting to protect Medicare and Medicaid, lower prescription drug costs, and make quality healthcare accessible to everyone.
**3\. Protecting Our Communities** Our communities deserve a say in decisions that affect their land, water, and electric bills. Maria opposes massive data center projects that put corporate profits ahead of residents, especially when taxpayers are asked to foot the bill.
**4\. A Government That Answers to You** Washington should work for everyday Americans, not wealthy donors and powerful corporations. Maria supports campaign finance reform, stronger government ethics rules, and an end to politicians profiting from insider information.
**5\. Putting People Before Politics** Maria believes we have more in common than what divides us. She's running to represent everyone in Ohio's 14th District, regardless of party affiliation. That means listening, finding common ground, and standing up for what's right, even when it isn't politically convenient.
**Five reasons. One goal. A stronger future for Northeast Ohio.**
If these are the things you believe in, help us spread the word. Share Maria's message with five friends and remind them to vote on November 3.

---
|
---
| |

**WE LOVE SEEING YOU OUT THERE** 💙

We love seeing your campaign spirit on social media! To everyone who's already voted early, thank you for taking part in this election.
Keep sharing your photos and stories on our social pages. We love seeing how our community is getting involved, and we appreciate every volunteer, supporter, and neighbor who's helping make this campaign possible.
---
|
---
| | **Are You Ready to Rock?**
Every great movement has its rock stars. And ours are the people who believe in what we're doing and step up to make it possible!
With just three weeks until Election Day, we're pulling out all the stops. Every contribution helps keep our campaign moving, our message reaching more people, and our volunteers equipped for the final stretch
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ASRCDK7VCZ7?e=27fb4eb2bd&c2id=b0ca7ec63a2b76e887e5a7a711fa5261)
| |

**Any amount helps. Join our tour.**
Admission $1, Roadie $10, Super Fan $50, Front Row $100, VIP $150, Headliner $250, Tour Boss $500, Rock Legend $1000.
---

---
|
---

**Hit forward. Pick five people. Done.**

You've officially done more for the campaign than most people do before breakfast.Good ideas spread one inbox at a time. Let yours be the first.

_The Angry Democrat welcomes guest writer Jennifer Brush, who shares her experience as a survivor of sexual violence and a retired U.S. diplomat, and her perspective on Vivek Ramaswamy 's attacks on Amy Acton. Guest op-eds reflect the views of their authors._
* * *
## Ohio Deserves Better
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/adcc4544-986b-4b16-9ce3-e3f249f9ef42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Democratic Gubernatorial Candidate Amy Acton
Amy Acton will be our next governor. The Republican Party should never again promote Vivek Ramaswamy for any position. He is spending $4 million on a campaign promoting the idea that Amy Acton lied about her rape 40 years ago, and he is asking us to believe that Acton's mother, who fled Ohio with her rapist husband and stayed with him until his death, did not lawfully lose custody of her children.
A man who promotes this sickening scenario should be governor of Ohio? Show him and his fellow Republicans you are better than this. None of the current Northeast Ohio Republican candidates, Jon Husted, David Joyce, or Max Miller, have denounced Ramaswamy's behavior. Do not vote for them either.
* * *
## The Statute of Limitations
In Ohio, it is estimated that one of every seven women will experience sexual assault in her lifetime. Ohio's statute of limitations, 25 years, with a five-year extension for DNA evidence, is one of the most lenient in the country.
At an Ohio Senate hearing in 2020, then-Judiciary Committee Chairman John Eklund (currently a judge of the 11th District Court of Appeals) tabled Senate Bill 162, which asked for the statute of limitations to be lifted for rape. His rationale was that any trial after 25 years could lead to unfair trial conditions because witnesses' recollections and evidence would be "dissipated."
At least 28 states have overcome this concern and have no criminal statute of limitations for felony rape. Even if Amy Acton's stepfather had been apprehended, he would only have been eligible to stand trial before she was 42 in the state of Ohio.
Amy Acton was brave to go public about her childhood abuse, though it is a matter of public record. She took actions recommended by health care professionals in seeking counseling and addressing her abuse head-on. Acton's actions help open the discussion on sexual violence, prosecution, and treatment.
The Department of Justice and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention report that between 70% and 88% of childhood sexual assaults go unreported. Acton reported her stepfather's crime, survived, and dedicated her life to public health. But she did not get the justice she deserved.
* * *
## My Own Experience
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6efe1a20-f994-4c3b-8b0f-58f9036835f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Survivor of Sexual Violence and a Retired U.S. diplomat: Jennifer Brush_
I was not so brave. In 1975, I was raped by a masked gunman and his accomplice while studying at Tulane University. I reported the rape and endured a rape kit procedure. New Orleans police bungled the investigation. There was no follow-up. I graduated and pursued a career in public service: diplomacy.
I was determined not to let this soul-searing experience interfere with my dreams. I spent 30 years serving the public as a U.S. diplomat in some of the world's most challenging environments. I served at the U.S. Embassy during the war in Bosnia-Herzegovina, traveled to Kosovo under martial law, and collected rape testimony from conservative Muslim women who had survived their Serbian assailants.
Though tempted, I never divulged my own experience with sexual violence. I only wanted them to see the American flag waving behind my head as I worked to bring them justice. Much of my reporting was used with the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia. Many Serbian military officers were indicted; most walk freely on the streets of Bosnia-Herzegovina, facing their victims on a regular basis. Bosnian laws make prosecution at this late date rare.
While serving as Organization for Security and Cooperation Head of Mission in Moldova, I worked to address Europe's highest incidences of domestic violence and sex trafficking. Again, speaking with survivors, I was tempted to share my experience but did not want to "dilute" my presence as a senior international diplomat.
For my own professional advancement, I kept my personal experience a secret. Would sharing have helped these women triumph over their traumatic experiences? I will never know, but it haunts me.
* * *
## Fifty Years After the Crime
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/77c37e30-9f96-4c58-838c-2968bcc0d289?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Professor Christine Blasey Ford
My post-retirement anger rose to a pitch during the 2018 Brett Kavanaugh hearings when respected Professor Christine Blasey Ford's testimony accusing Kavanaugh of sexual assault was dismissed.
Outraged, I wrote to the Cleveland Plain Dealer, singling out the Blasey Ford fiasco as proof of why so many women preferred to stay silent rather than endure the doubts and abuse the U.S. Senate dumped on Blasey Ford.
[https://www.cleveland.com/opinion/2018/09/the_price_and_the_lure_of_rema.html](https://substack.com/redirect/d270bbfb-81b4-49f9-9c0f-cd8c19220b36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
My op-ed caught the attention of [then-Cuyahoga Sex Crimes Coordinator Rick Bell](https://substack.com/redirect/d26d7841-9699-4598-801e-9e382836e693?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I spoke to his unit about my then-45-year-old assault, and he offered to check on the status with his counterpart in New Orleans.
A few months later, I received the astonishing phone call that my rape kit had been recovered along with the DNA and that my attacker was alive and living in New Orleans. There was no statute of limitations in Louisiana. Neither my memory of the attack nor the evidence had "dissipated."
After five years of pretrial proceedings, COVID, and a mistrial, my assailant finally was sentenced to life without parole in 2025, 50 years after the crime.
Did the assault scar me for life? Yes. Did it stop me? No.
* * *
## Beneath Contempt
A survivor's worst nightmare is to be judged and, worse, doubted. That is what Vivek Ramaswamy is doing to Amy Acton. It is beneath contempt for any human being. But for someone who wants to be governor of Ohio?

A man who promotes this sickening scenario should be governor of Ohio? Show him and his fellow Republicans you are better than this. The Statute of Limitations In Ohio, it is estimated that one of every seven women will experience sexual assault in her lifetime. Ohio's statute of limitations, 25 years, with a five-year extension for DNA evidence, is one of the most lenient in the country. At an Ohio Senate hearing in 2020, then-Judiciary Committee Chairman John Eklund (currently a judge of the 11th District Court of Appeals) tabled Senate Bill 162, which asked for the statute of limitations to be lifted for rape. His rationale was that any trial after 25 years could lead to unfair trial conditions because witnesses' recollections and evidence would be "dissipated." At least 28 states have overcome this concern and have no criminal statute of limitations for felony rape. Even if Amy Acton's stepfather had been apprehended, he would only have been eligible to stand trial before she was 42 in the state of Ohio. Acton's actions help open the discussion on sexual violence, prosecution, and treatment. subject: I have seen this playbook before -- and it works if we let it

Democrats are flooding red states with outside money. Montana cannot be the one that slips away. |

FROM THE DESK OF SENATOR JOHN THUNE:
I want to be direct with you about something I am watching closely.

Democrats are not just playing defense this cycle. They are on offense - targeting red states they have no business competing in, flooding them with outside money, and running candidates specifically designed to fool voters into thinking they are getting a moderate when they are actually getting another loyal Schumer vote.

**Montana is one of those states. But I refuse to let it slip away without a fight.**

**[Fellow Conservative, that is why I am asking you to stand with Trump-endorsed Kurt Alme today.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cd0fd65ef6b6420abc3faf1f30f42ba6&_e=L3mtQB2G235Eq4Vn0p6OmAh1AvAAsazsGXia8HOY_OPYLU-zw8G-qWB2aN0k9LMeooz_5CZkQNmqrX71S0nD0MJcMF0UtpkbNkGvIg1Oj-uFzB8nrEgcjRmSYPBKnPGQ5Ev_YC5gF1plmWi613bHOoWdFfJ543irD_7mcJUZiooJYpiNhmrPnT14MMTstDGc-l-lF1LjVotu6L0Wa6IApW5_3iH4KWluyv_o2rDveSirXLL0qJPyZRVZGHuj28zQisshn3u8oJaVkBvExJ6SVL9YoyQJY-ufVrjgcktWpQdVaj6t1u4umG5yx-jfmIFPVYk7xSsjjRSkDcMqBWh3uOtuN-5WId1MPFE8GBEA10pkTSBRSddxZ23LT40B3AnGi9gkB9fjFBwCdlEvI562azdIvoTWpc-SUjcpLhoF_CBbWu7DK5SVY09oF_m-6sCIKUfa1xh7g9Se8JbpgNdwvbWsba9uQHzrh8Du2QdAm4RcZ7fa3dRnwIG-NXqiyAmuY6u6tO3wPpXAXW8QkK29-QgaYgmU4jQ3tURjJ4AHTurNuxJcqrNt-fhCCz1C3ZyZM9hv0ZaIuclTt6FSEvFLyyGtDH-bxU8ReK_OTErzW6DX5YHUsc5ebNpslJPye0c3xUiMhaibd19uDavzAvimlAfW9CCQHDCrfMdpvYTWJQ93JNtxYr8LIVH8rXhOlD_4nSMRzyB-ykPnKPJdc8LKPy8u7ijQzr_JAF_6i90T7TE%3D) ** [**STAND WITH KURT >>**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cd0fd65ef6b6420abc3faf1f30f42ba6&_e=L3mtQB2G235Eq4Vn0p6OmAh1AvAAsazsGXia8HOY_OPYLU-zw8G-qWB2aN0k9LMeooz_5CZkQNmqrX71S0nD0MJcMF0UtpkbNkGvIg1Oj-uFzB8nrEgcjRmSYPBKnPGQ5Ev_YC5gF1plmWi613bHOoWdFfJ543irD_7mcJUZiooJYpiNhmrPnT14MMTstDGc-l-lF1LjVotu6L0Wa6IApW5_3iH4KWluyv_o2rDveSirXLL0qJPyZRVZGHuj28zQZO9Opodvdv2Snb_iaUtImaVF1IFXe5-x8c-TRj5B__-6HwNM1JUfBGr9XtvfUbxuP29drFR59ts_JfY8tqGVFzc7WHEjNWm1XyngqQ4wVNItcbKt3F--UzWxDi6-4ktpSTXr5azN_rm6pwgYFFli4qn9HgFFt-VnU2QJe5p3Yu-nkVloJBmcefxKGYhdhO0blfxPni7HxHij_fn_FaiztaX6B4wBf7cmn7t3dp57rA0geAe5eQSawWszt3Sh04_zYC7GlHITgriC6Yvz1KTanN2D9UI7stXTFkBPMZoh4kch_F6GeEsztbJtVz3_3BoqaTIyAwOZaHZNcc5OTNBkYYPYX1dGoD-cxUbjql9j8IWO2d4ZBDYE83NtNGw-NZ2_b21xJiqIRA6DXyQFwiW2NaMiN3yxYS3nbMFgGPcsqCNfXi8gxPgxEK5Tut3nhj3Pk_MOCcnIVXYIJ1YgwUGkOXREKqXxyRCyu4eUGq6ATlQ%3D)

I refuse to let that happen here.

Kurt Alme is exactly the kind of candidate Montana needs - a Trump-nominated federal prosecutor with a real record of results. He took on cartels, drug traffickers, and violent criminals as U.S. attorney. He cut Montana's income tax rate. He helped make Montana debt-free. **_He has President Trump's complete and total endorsement, and mine._**

But here is the reality. Schumer has two candidates in this race, both funded by out-of-state money, both running the same bait-and-switch playbook we have seen in state after state. They are not running to represent Montana. They are running to give the Senate back to Chuck Schumer.

Fellow Conservative, maintaining our Senate Republican Majority is not just about this seat - it is about our ability to confirm conservative judges, advance President Trump's agenda, and provide a check on Washington's excesses. _Every seat matters. This one especially._

clean_body: Democrats are flooding red states with outside money. Montana cannot be the one that slips away. | FROM THE DESK OF SENATOR JOHN THUNE: I want to be direct with you about something I am watching closely. Democrats are not just playing defense this cycle. They are on offense - targeting red states they have no business competing in, flooding them with outside money, and running candidates specifically designed to fool voters into thinking they are getting a moderate when they are actually getting another loyal Schumer vote. Montana is one of those states. But I refuse to let it slip away without a fight. I have served in the Senate long enough to know how these races unfold. Democrats identify a target, recruit a candidate, and pour in millions of dollars before the Republican side has had time to build. By the time conservatives see what is happening, the gap is already significant. I refuse to let that happen here. Kurt Alme is exactly the kind of candidate Montana needs - a Trump-nominated federal prosecutor with a real record of results. He took on cartels, drug traffickers, and violent criminals as U.S. attorney. He cut Montana's income tax rate. He helped make Montana debt-free. He has President Trump's complete and total endorsement, and mine. But here is the reality. Schumer has two candidates in this race, both funded by out-of-state money, both running the same bait-and-switch playbook we have seen in state after state. They are not running to represent Montana. They are running to give the Senate back to Chuck Schumer. Fellow Conservative, maintaining our Senate Republican Majority is not just about this seat - it is about our ability to confirm conservative judges, advance President Trump's agenda, and provide a check on Washington's excesses. Every seat matters. This one especially. I hope we can count on you. Thank you, - John Thune P.S. Democrats are targeting Montana because they think they can flip it. We spent the first week doing a lot of fundraising for other candidates, and over the last few days we’ve started raising for ourselves.
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark.
I know you’ve gotten a number of emails from my team already this month. We spent the first week doing a lot of fundraising for other candidates, but since then we’ve been raising for ourselves. Because, yes, we’ve still got goals to hit.
Even now. Even this close to the election.
So, with that in mind, I’m writing to ask, both humbly and respectfully, if you can make a donation to help us hit those goals.
I love this country. That’s why I joined the Navy and NASA, and it’s why I ran for the U.S. Senate. All I’ve ever wanted to do is serve.
Last year, when I knew the odds were stacked against us, I took a job as Vice Chair of the DSCC. The map was tough, our opponents had all of the momentum, all of the resources, and we were starting from close to zero. But I took that job because I thought I could do some good.
I’ve been working with the candidates who will win a majority in the Senate over those last two years, and I’m proud to tell you: It’s within our reach.
It took a lot of work to get to this point, and now’s no time to quit.

Hi friend, it's Jason Crow.

Donald Trump believes that fear is contagious. He wants people to be gripped by fear and look to him for protection. That's his plan to get us all to bow down.

**_It's up to us to have courage instead. _**

I believe we will, because that's what Americans do.

Our country was built on rejecting kings. We won't stand for any more of this corruption. And something big is happening, friend: Our courage is spreading like wildfire.

Americans are stepping up all over. They are protecting their friends, protecting their neighbors, mobilizing, organizing, bearing witness.

_That's_ the America I know and love. That is New American Patriotism. It makes me proud as hell.

In November, we can put stronger guardrails on Trump's authoritarian ambitions by electing a Democratic majority. We can protect our Democracy, prioritize affordability, and get our country back on track.

The best news? We're only **_three seats_** away.

But we are up against some of the most aggressive far-right spending we've ever seen. The GOP is rushing to protect its vulnerable incumbents, and it will be an uphill battle. They've got billionaire backers and dark-money PACs on their side.

Friend, I’m reaching out to ask for your help because my team and I just made the difficult decision to double our post-debate goal. We need to raise $500,000 by 11:59 p.m. on Oct. 23, and **[anything you can spare would be a huge help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141983576/655396771/-540544497?amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk738&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjYxMjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzVmNTBkOWUtNjJjZS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=W6Ea729DHqRfj5cSYuVF1VhPZYdqHExz7k3MNp2NcSU=)**
Let me back up a bit. In recent weeks, a **top GOP super PAC has diverted millions from North Carolina to launch a massive ad campaign here in Kansas in support of my opponent. Tom Shattuck, Steve Robinson, Jon Fetherston, Seamus Othot and Graham react to AOC and Troy Jackson's Portland event. The panel plays her answers to student questions on transgender rights and Title IX and on public transit in rural Maine, and Jackson's remarks on health insurance. From Lewiston City Hall, Fetherston talks with a city councilor and a concerned citizen; the councilor describes a group holding signs in the hallway outside early voting, and Robinson walks through Maine's 250-foot electioneering law. They also relay word from City Hall that an election warden asked an interpreter to leave the voting area.

| | This midterm election isn't just about putting a check on Trump for the last 2 years of his presidency; it's also a chance to begin the critical work of passing an affordability agenda and reimagining our health care system. These are extraordinary times, and they call for bold solutions. And one of these solutions is **Medicare for All.** I'm hopeful that come January 2027, I'll have new allies in the Senate who are ready to fight alongside me to make this idea a reality. I'd like to highlight three potential new colleagues today:
* Dr. Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan — who literally wrote the book on Medicare for All and has dedicated his career to making care more accessible, efficient, and affordable
* State Rep. Angie Nixon of Florida — a union organizer and working mother who understands that health care must be a right, not a privilege tied to one's paycheck
* Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan of Minnesota — whose health care as a child was Medicaid, and for whom this fight is personal

All three of these candidates are principled, inspiring leaders. And they're all polling competitively with just 12 days left. [**A Senate with people like Abdul, Peggy, and Angie in it is a Senate that will work a whole lot better for the American people. clean_body: Congress must urgently call for an end to Trump’s voter suppression attempts| | | | | | Team,We've told you before: MAGA media personality and former Trump adviser, Steve Bannon, called for ICE to "surround the polls " on Election Day. Trump said earlier this year that he's willing to send ICE and National Guard troops to polling places. Markwayne Mullin, head of the Department of Homeland Security, wouldn't rule out ICE from showing up to voting locations to address so-called, unspecified "threats." The White House should have unequivocally ruled out such a clearly illegal act of voter intimidation, but it won't, because they want to spread fear before the midterms. Congress must speak out now against sending ICE and troops to the polls, then pass legislation to protect the vote from armed, authoritarian scare tactics. Democratic Senators have introduced two pieces of legislation that double down on prohibiting armed military and federal agents from terrorizing polling places: the Protect Our Polls Act and the Safe Access to the Polls Act. "President Trump is pulling every lever he has to weaponize the federal government and undermine our elections — and that includes him threatening to send armed federal agents to our polling places ," said Senator Tammy Baldwin, sponsor of the Safe Access to the Polls Act. Trump fired independent election monitors, installed election deniers in key administration positions, threatened criminal charges against states who don't follow his anti-democratic election orders, and launched an all-out attack on mail voting — moves that present direct threats to voting on November 3rd. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: We need to win these races
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x

Stopping Trump and the MAGA movement this
November means competing in tough races across the country, and every
single one matters. These are the handful of Senate races that I’m
watching especially closely.

These candidates are all taking on corporate greed, fighting to bring down
costs, and standing up to Trump. They know whose side they’re on: working
people, not the wealthy special interests that have too much power in
Washington.

Here’s who I’m counting on to help Democrats win up and down the ballot
this November, and why I’m asking you to help them win.

* Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan (U.S. Senate): Abdul is a doctor and public
health leader who knows that health care is a right, not a privilege.
He won a hard-fought primary on a platform of getting big money out of
politics, lowering health care costs, and passing Medicare for All.
Now he’s running in one of the country's most important battleground
states. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3869?t=1006&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x ]Chip in today to help Abdul win in Michigan and fight for
working people in the Senate.
* Angie Nixon, Florida (U.S. Senate): In her primary, Angie beat a
candidate who outraised her by more than ten to one. She’s a former
union organizer who has fought corporate price gouging and stood up
for working families struggling with Florida’s affordability crisis.
Now Republicans want to write off her primary victory as a fluke.
[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3870?t=1007&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x ]Chip in to Angie’s campaign and show them just how wrong they are.
* Mary Peltola, Alaska (U.S. Senate): As the first Alaska Native elected
to Congress, Mary is a fighter for working people. I love her slogan:
Fish. Family. Freedom. Alaska is a wildcard, but this race is
winnable, and whichever party wins it will very likely control the
Senate majority. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3871?t=1008&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x ]Donate to help send Mary to the Senate for Alaska.
* James Talarico, Texas (U.S. Senate): James started out as a middle
school teacher, and he knows this fight is about the top versus the
bottom. Now he’s running against Ken Paxton, a man Texas House
Republicans voted to impeach in 2023. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3872?t=1009&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x ]Donate to help James make
history and send a Democrat to the Senate from Texas for the first
time since 1988.
* Peggy Flanagan, Minnesota (U.S. Senate): Peggy is the real deal. She
fought to raise Minnesota’s minimum wage and tie it to inflation. When
ICE descended on Minnesota, she stood strong against Trump’s attacks.
And she refuses to take a dime of corporate PAC money. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3873?t=1010&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x ]Donate to
help send a fighter who answers to working people, not corporate
interests, to the Senate.
* Sherrod Brown, Ohio (U.S. Senate): Sherrod and I have fought side by
side for years, taking on Wall Street and standing up for working
people. He led the fight to pass the Social Security Fairness Act,
helping teachers, firefighters, and police officers get the full
benefits they earned. Now he’s fighting to win back his Senate seat in
Ohio. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3874?t=1011&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x ]Chip in to help Sherrod get back to the Senate.
* Troy Jackson, Maine (U.S. Senate): Troy is a logger, a union man, and
the real deal. He’s led the fight to lower prescription drug costs in
Maine, and he isn’t afraid to take on billionaires. Susan Collins has
been in the Senate for nearly 30 years, and Mainers deserve a senator
who will stand up to Trump and fight for them. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3875?t=1012&akid=3060%2E4032634%2E_Ce91x ]This race is close.
Send Troy a gift today to help flip this seat.

Getting Democrats in key political positions means we can block Trump’s
extreme judicial nominees, hold his administration accountable, and fight
to lower costs and protect working families.

But Republicans won’t give up their majority without a fight. They’re
spending big to hold onto power, and our candidates need the resources to
compete, organize, and get their message out to voters.

It will
take winning races across the country, often by just a few thousand votes,
to take back the Senate. Every single race matters, and every contribution
helps these campaigns reach more voters and build the support they need.

If you can’t give right now, you can still make a difference. Make calls,
send texts, knock on doors, or share these candidates’ messages with
friends and family. Visit their campaign websites to find out how you can
get involved.

And whatever else you do, for Pete’s sake, make sure you vote on November
3.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

| | | By pure luck, no one was killed at the Hindu temple in Aurora last week. According to prosecutors, a rifle jammed. That is the difference between this email and a very different one. **_I was there. I was watching my 80-year-old mother and 87-year-old father sing prayers on the first day of Navaratri. Countless people were there._** A 19-year-old with a rifle and a head full of hatred had come to our temple. Prosecutors say he tried to open fire. When it jammed, he went home, and, as I said at a news conference, he researched how to fix it. Then he told a coworker he planned to go back. That coworker picked up a phone. **I don’t know how my family and others escaped. I will never stop thinking about it.** This white supremacist shooter apparently plotted for two years, and nobody knew. His writings were full of hate for Indian Americans, and for Black and Jewish Americans too. It mirrors the hatred we see online every day toward Indian Americans, South Asians, and Hindu Americans, and so many others. Big Tech is profiting off of that hate. I said last week that we cannot wait until innocent people are killed to take these threats seriously. I meant every word. So I’ll ask the question plainly: how many more people need to die before we do? I’ve called on the FBI to investigate this as a hate crime, and I’m pushing for hate crime charges. I’ll keep fighting for the bipartisan Hate Crimes Commission I’ve championed for years, so we can finally understand what’s driving this and stop it. The community at that temple is shaken, but it isn’t hiding. You have to be yourself, whoever you are, and practice your beliefs, whatever they are. This country belongs to all of us. This has given me a new purpose. It’s why I started Equal Opportunity Now: to elect leaders who treat hate violence as a threat before it kills, who hold Big Tech accountable for profiting from it, and who will never again wait for a tragedy to act. **[Help me build that Congress. Chip in $20 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today. When it jammed, he went home, and, as I said at a news conference, he researched how to fix it. Then he told a coworker he planned to go back. That coworker picked up a phone. I don’t know how my family and others escaped. I will never stop thinking about it. This white supremacist shooter apparently plotted for two years, and nobody knew. His writings were full of hate for Indian Americans, and for Black and Jewish Americans too. It mirrors the hatred we see online every day toward Indian Americans, South Asians, and Hindu Americans, and so many others. Big Tech is profiting off of that hate. I said last week that we cannot wait until innocent people are killed to take these threats seriously. I meant every word. So I’ll ask the question plainly: how many more people need to die before we do? I’ve called on the FBI to investigate this as a hate crime, and I’m pushing for hate crime charges. I’ll keep fighting for the bipartisan Hate Crimes Commission I’ve championed for years, so we can finally understand what’s driving this and stop it. The community at that temple is shaken, but it isn’t hiding. You have to be yourself, whoever you are, and practice your beliefs, whatever they are. This country belongs to all of us. This has given me a new purpose. It’s why I started Equal Opportunity Now: to elect leaders who treat hate violence as a threat before it kills, who hold Big Tech accountable for profiting from it, and who will never again wait for a tragedy to act. = = | | | How many more people need to die? None. Not one more. — Raja Krishnamoorthi Founder | Equal Opportunity Now | = Equal Opportunity Now is d/b/a Reviving American Jobs Again PAC (RAJA PAC) Equal Opportunity Now P.O. body:
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=1158%2E127862%2ELSwywl)
Folks,
I need you to remember two numbers: **0.4%** and **0.7%.**
**0.4%** is how much I won by the first time I ran for Attorney General back in 2018. Less than half a percentage point. Out of hundreds of thousands of votes cast across Nevada, that’s all that separated winning from losing.
I didn’t win that race because I had the most money. I won it because thousands of grassroots supporters chipped in what they could, when it mattered most. Those $5 and $10 donations kept our campaign strong and put our message in front of voters right up until the last ballot was cast. **In a race that close, every one of those dollars made the difference.**
Now, for the second number.
**0.7%** is the tiny lead MS NOW’s polling average gives MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo right now. Less than one point. And with early voting already underway, it’s going to come down to which campaign does the most in these final days.
Lombardo has his billionaire donors. I have you. _And I’ve seen firsthand what grassroots supporters can do in a race this close._
**[I’m respectfully asking you to chip in to our campaign before time runs out. Can you chip in $5 to make sure we have what it takes to win?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261022_3_ak.wUOB03&amount=5&refcode=em20261022-1145&t=3&akid=1158%2E127862%2ELSwywl)**

Thank you,
Aaron

body:
Join Swing Left and a lineup of amazing comedians this Monday to learn how to talk to voters.
#
Hi there,
We have an exciting event coming up next Monday that we think you’ll enjoy!
**On Monday, October 26th, some of America’s funniest comedians are teaming up with Swing Left for PORCH FRIGHT, a virtual evening of laughs, learnings, and voter-mobilizing magic to help us put a real check on the Trump administration and change our country's future.**
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3207?t=1&akid=3253%2E1562180%2EWHUc_Z)
If the idea of talking with strangers about voting makes you a little nervous, you’re not alone. So we’re bringing in some people who know a thing or two about talking to strangers.
Lisandra Vasquez, Maya May, Matthew Broussard, Irene Tu, Sasheer Zamata, and a few surprise friends have turned talking to strangers into an art form. At this event, they’ll show you how to:
🎃 **Take the “hell” out of hello.** Break the ice without breaking into a cold sweat.
👻 **Turn “I'm not voting” into an actual conversation.** No ghosting, guilt trips, or political jump scares required.
🦇 **Share your why without oversharing.** Keep it personal, powerful, and mercifully brief.
🗳️ **Help a soon-to-be voter make a plan.** Because good intentions are great; a plan to vote is even better.
🚪 **Get out there and knock some doors.** Talk with as many voters as you can before November 3rd—and make every conversation count.
You don’t need any experience to join us. Just show up, laugh, and leave ready to flip seats—because the most terrifying prospect of all is another two-plus years of unchecked Trump administration chaos.
[**Click here to RSVP now and join us on Monday, October 26th!**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3207?t=2&akid=3253%2E1562180%2EWHUc_Z)
**[RSVP Now »](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3207?t=3&akid=3253%2E1562180%2EWHUc_Z)**
We hope to see you there!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261022-2&t=4&refcode2=3253_1562180_WHUc_Z&akid=3253%2E1562180%2EWHUc_Z)

| | Peter, at a recent town hall, a man named Tommy asked me this: _“Will you disavow the Muslim Brotherhood?”_ I said, “Yeah, absolutely.” Then I asked him why he was asking _me_ this. You already know the answer. He assumed that because I’m Muslim, my loyalty must belong to something other than the Constitution. I reminded Tommy that John F. Kennedy got asked whether he'd have allegiance to the Pope, because he was Catholic. Same question, same assumption. Peter, I’m not running to be a Muslim senator. I’m running for the U.S. Senate, and I happen to be Muslim. **The Constitution is my guiding light, and I’ll fight to protect the right to pray or not pray as you choose for _all_ Americans, including Tommy.** That clip has been viewed more than *44 million times* online. I think it went viral because of how perfectly it captures a core aspect of this race: **Republicans are attacking my faith because they have _nothing else to run on._ ** Michiganders are paying too much for groceries, gas, and healthcare. And Mike Rogers has no real solutions to those issues. He’s simply running to be an errand boy for Donald Trump. So the same weekend as that town hall, Rogers ramped up his baseless Muslim Brotherhood attacks, and Donald Trump continued to mispronounce my name and try twisting it into a punchline. **They’re betting that if they make voters afraid of me, nobody will notice who’s actually been robbing them.** But a viral clip isn’t enough. With two weeks to go, Michigan voters need to hear the truth from us before the GOP’s attacks reach them. clean_body: | | | | | Peter, at a recent town hall, a man named Tommy asked me this: “Will you disavow the Muslim Brotherhood?” I said, “Yeah, absolutely.” Then I asked him why he was asking me this. You already know the answer. He assumed that because I’m Muslim, my loyalty must belong to something other than the Constitution. I reminded Tommy that John F. Kennedy got asked whether he'd have allegiance to the Pope, because he was Catholic. Same question, same assumption. Peter, I’m not running to be a Muslim senator. I’m running for the U.S. Senate, and I happen to be Muslim. The Constitution is my guiding light, and I’ll fight to protect the right to pray or not pray as you choose for all Americans, including Tommy. That clip has been viewed more than 44 million times online. I think it went viral because of how perfectly it captures a core aspect of this race: Republicans are attacking my faith because they have nothing else to run on. Michiganders are paying too much for groceries, gas, and healthcare. And Mike Rogers has no real solutions to those issues. He’s simply running to be an errand boy for Donald Trump. So the same weekend as that town hall, Rogers ramped up his baseless Muslim Brotherhood attacks, and Donald Trump continued to mispronounce my name and try twisting it into a punchline. They’re betting that if they make voters afraid of me, nobody will notice who’s actually been robbing them. But a viral clip isn’t enough. You've heard Democrats talk about a "blue wave" this year. But what's really powering their Senate campaigns is a GREEN WAVE of cash. And it's crashing over the Senate map right now. Look at the latest FEC reports, covering July through September: ▶ **TEXAS** : James Talarico (D) raised $60.2 million. Ken Paxton (R) raised $10.2 million.
▶ **KANSAS** : Adam Hamilton (D) raised $9.4 million. Roger Marshall (R) raised $800,000.
▶ **GEORGIA** : Jon Ossoff (D) raised $33.1 million. Mike Collins (R) raised $2.8 million.

You may have seen headlines bragging about record Republican super PAC money. The GOP's top Senate super PAC just raised a record $272.9 million in a single quarter. Here's what those headlines leave out: **a super PAC dollar doesn't go nearly as far as a candidate dollar.** Federal law requires TV and radio stations to sell ad time to candidates at their LOWEST UNIT RATE in the final 60 days before a general election. That's the same rate the station gives its best commercial customer. Super PACs don't get that rate. They pay whatever the station charges. During a football game in Austin in September, a Republican super PAC was charged $450,000 to air a single ad. Talarico's campaign paid $50,000 for a spot in the same game, in the same market. **That's NINE TIMES the price.**

For years, the Left has built a national small-dollar machine. Liberal donors don't just give to candidates at home. They give to candidates in states they've never visited. Talarico has raised more than $122 million from individual donors this cycle, and more than $65 million of it came from small donors giving $200 or less. Peter,
Normally when you see my name in your inbox, I like the messages to be different from the other emails you get from most elected officials.
I've written to you in detail about the depth of corruption and self-enrichment of the Trump Administration, the President's thirst for political retribution and intimidation, along with other things I am seeing or working on in Washington, D.C. and at home in Georgia.
This message is different. It's more direct.
I am reaching out today with a humble request for a contribution to my campaign. Here's why:
Voting is underway in Georgia, and we have to treat every day like Election Day. We have to work relentlessly to turn out the voters we need to decisively win this race.
Because Georgia remains the pivotal battleground state.
I won this Senate seat by just 1.2% in 2021, and Republicans are determined to defeat me and take it back. That’s why JD Vance and Donald Trump both came to Georgia this month to rally their supporters and uplift my opponent, Mike Collins.
There are many paths to a Democratic Senate majority. **But all of those paths depend upon defending this seat in Georgia.**
So with less than 13 days until the polls close, it’s time to take action and use the power that we have as citizens to make a difference and regain Congressional power.
[**We have to win, and we have to win decisively on November 3. So I’m asking, humbly, if you will chip in $5 to my reelection campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261022-5-f&utm_campaign=em261022-5-f&amount=5&t=2&akid=3152%2E5691347%2ELhS96Z)

Thank you,
Jon

clean_body: 12 days left, let’s get it done | | = Friend, We hope you watched Rachel wipe the floor with a sweaty, sniffing, unprepared Dan Meuser this week. With less than two weeks to go, we’re running through the tape, so check out our updates and we hope you’ll join us in finishing strong! Ways To Get Involved This Week 1. Last chance to get involved at a town hall! Next stop is Bloomsburg (10/28), and our final stop is in Pottsville (10/29) next week. You can find all the details — make sure you share with your friends, and we’ll see you out there! 2. Sign up to canvass! We are hitting the pavement nearly every day around the district to get out the word about Rachel. 3. ** Whether you come to our office in Pottsville or you choose to make calls from your couch, we need your help calling voters to make sure they have a plan to vote. Sign up to join us on Tuesdays at 6:00 PM for our team phone bank! What We’ve Been Up To We’ve been busy this past week! Here’s a recap: Lebanon showed up last Saturday as we rallied for change this November. Thanks to the over 150 people who came out on Monday in Williamsport to talk about the issues that matter, from holding insurance companies accountable to supporting our local beef producers in Lycoming County. Two weeks to go. Let’s bring it home. Connecting with Robesonia: On Sunday, Rachel met with residents of Robesonia for a Berks County meet and greet where we talked about Social Security, the national debt, data centers, and more. : On Tuesday night, Rachel faced off against Dan Meuser in a debate at Penn State Schuylkill, sharing her vision for the future of Pennsylvania’s 9th Congressional District and the issues that matter most to our communities. She showed a clear contrast to Meuser -- who doesn’t live here, doesn’t fight for us, and only cares about his bottom line. Check out our social on the debate below and share with your friends! lower costs, end corruption, and give our communities a say in any AI data centers that want to come here. Dan Meuser is fighting for himself, and the contrast was clear. — If you have events in your area you’d like to invite Rachel to, please get in touch with us atmailto:info@wallaceforcongress.com. Upcoming Events and Volunteer Opportunities Help us get the word out about our town hall tour and meet and greet events. Join us to meet Rachel, share what’s on your mind, and get your questions answered. Make sure to RSVP at the link and share with your friends. October 28, 6-8PM: October 29, 6-8PM: November 3, 7:30-10PM: Election Night Party Canvass in your county! We have opportunities across the district — Make calls to get out the vote! No matter where you live, you can join the campaign by making calls every Tuesday until the election.** Join us from home or at the Pottsville office on Tuesdays from 6-8PM to make calls to voters across the district and get out the vote. With less than two weeks to go, let’s give this everything we got. We’re so grateful for your support. Introducing LinkUp: Text Your Friends to Get Out the Vote

We're excited to launch LinkUp, a new Right Insight feature that lets you personally text your friends and contacts. A message
from someone they know and trust is one of the most powerful ways to get people to the polls.

How to get started:

1. Log in to Right Insight and tap LinkUp at the bottom of your screen.

2. Tap Sync in the top right corner to upload your contacts. Give it a moment to load.

3. You'll now see your contacts, along with their voter registration status and how they're voting.

4. Tap a contact you'd like to message.

5. If you have more than one number for that person, select the right phone number.

6. Set your organization to Minnesota Republican Party.

7. Choose a pre-written message template, or type your own, then tap Send Message.

Texts go out directly from your phone, so your friends see a message from you, just like any other text.

Join the push. Reach out to your friends, remind them to vote, and help our Republican candidates win.

A note from Senator Ashley Moody |
---
Peter,
I'm going to be honest with you, because I don't know any other way to say this.
My heart breaks for France right now. City halls burning to the ground. More than 600 police officers injured in a single day. Rioters tearing the French flag off the monument to their own Republic – and raising a Palestinian flag in its place, while others march under the hammer and sickle.
Communists and radical Islamists, side by side in the streets. **That 's not a coincidence. That's an alliance.** And it has eyes on more than Europe.
This radical movement is working to infiltrate our own country – and it's counting on patriots like you not realizing it until it's too late.
It is the honor of my life to serve as Florida's U.S. Senator. My state is full of people who already know how this story ends. Families who fled Castro with nothing but the clothes on their backs. Venezuelans who watched their country get looted by socialists in a single generation. Nicaraguans who escaped Ortega. They came here because America was the one place it couldn't happen.
Here, that movement has a fellow traveler on the ballot, and her name is **Angie Nixon.**
She runs a bookstore called "Cafe Resistance." On its wall hang portraits of convicted cop killers – including Assata Shakur, who murdered a New Jersey state trooper and fled to Castro's Cuba. When she was confronted about it, she said she stands by "everything in this bookstore."
She closes her speeches with a line from the Communist Manifesto – "We have nothing to lose but our chains" – and she took that chant to a CAIR gala.
